items.briefDescription: "Outstanding Exporter" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises” by the Industries & Commerce Dept, Puducherry, awards the direct manufacture exporters that are exporting for 3 years.

items.briefDescription: "Outstanding SC/ST Entrepreneur" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises” is a scheme by the Industries and Commerce Dept, UT of Puducherry, formulated to award the best SC/ST entrepreneurs.
items.schemeName: "Outstanding SC/ST Entrepreneur" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises”

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the farmers are provided Poly House, Shade Net House (Tubular Structure), Plastic Mulching at subsidised rates for practising Protected Cultivation. items.briefDescription: The objective of the "Reactivation Of Fisheries Cooperative Societies" scheme is to provide a one-time revolving fund of ₹2,00,000/- to each eligible Primary Fishermen Cooperative Society for working capital of the society and improvement of the socio-economic status of the members in the long run.

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to support SC/ST and women entrepreneurs who have initiated production on or after 27-3-2002 in a rented building. items.briefDescription: "Super 30" was launched by the Directorate of Secondary Education, Tripura. items.schemeName: "SUPER 30" Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, Promotion Campaigns, Exhibitions, Trade Fairs, Investors Meets, Seminars etc., are arranged in important towns/cities of India and abroad, to attract industries to invest in Puducherry. This will help them in increasing the marketability of these products.
items.schemeName: 'Organizing/ Participation in Exhibitions /Trade Fairs /Expo /Seminars /Investors Meets, etc' under 'Marketing And Publicity'

items.briefDescription: In this scheme, financial support will be provided via the Industrial Associations, Handicrafts Societies and Recognized Institutions for promotion of Handicrafts, Coir, Jute, Micro and Small Industrial products, i.e. for acquiring suitable buildings/premises and providing infrastructure facilities.
items.schemeName: 'Rent Subsidy for Sales Emporia Established by Handicrafts / Micro & Small Industries Emporium' under 'Marketing And Publicity'

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to beneficiaries of the Gujarat Housing Board and Slum Clearance Cell who have pending installment dues by offering a complete waiver of penalty amounts. It benefits tenants and property allottees by waiving 100% penalties on arrears if paid by 31st March.

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides provide financial support to native residents of Gujarat who have a disability of 40% or more. The eligible individuals can avail of a term loan ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate of 6% per annum for a repayment period of five years.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide timely emergency medical assistance by transporting patients to hospitals and offering essential first aid through a free, state-wide ambulance service accessible by calling 108.

items.briefDescription: The "15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training" scheme aims to provide skill training, safety, and hygiene education for building and other construction workers registered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
items.schemeName: 15 Days Skill Up-gradation Training

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a 25% concession in travel fare for tribals belonging to the tribal areas of Rajasthan State while traveling in local ordinary bus services.

items.briefDescription: The Union Territory of Lakshadweep has implemented the scheme “25% Capital Investment Subsidy” to provide financial assistance to local entrepreneurs for promoting Micro and small Enterprises in Lakshadweep.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide affordable and accessible public transport by offering a 30 percent concession in travel fare to women and girls traveling within the Rajasthan State boundary.

items.briefDescription: The "40% subsidy on Hank Yarn, Dyes & Chemicals Scheme" is a Subsidy Scheme by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh. items.schemeName: 40% Subsidy On Hank Yarn, Dyes & Chemicals Scheme

items.schemeName: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken for Vehicle Purchase through Banks

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce financial stress for ST students pursuing foreign education by providing up to ₹1,50,000 subsidy on interest for 3 years.

items.schemeName: 60% and above Disability Allowances

by Students / faculty of AICTE approved Institutions in the field of technical education.

items.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH-based interventions to improve community health outcomes by supporting preventive, promotive, curative, and rehabilitative healthcare services.

items.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH interventions for the treatment and rehabilitation of sports injuries and to enhance health and fitness among sports persons.
items.schemeName: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

items.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to support the establishment and up-gradation of reputed institutions to Centres of Excellence for strengthening AYUSH education, research, innovation, and advanced healthcare services.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance India's manufacturing capabilities and exports of traditional medicines and health promotion products under the initiative of Atmanirbhar Bharat.
items.schemeName: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to establish a robust safety monitoring and surveillance system for Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Homoeopathy (ASU&H) drugs and to monitor misleading advertisements related to Ayush medicines.
items.schemeName: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Pharmacovigilance of ASU&H Drugs Including Surveillance of Misleading Advertisements

items.schemeName: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Strengthening of Central and State Regulatory Frameworks Including Technical Human Resource and Capacity Building Programs for Ayush Drugs

items.briefDescription: AB PM-JAY is a health insurance scheme for low-income families in rural and urban areas. The scheme aims to provide affordable healthcare facilities to the Poor. It is the largest health assurance scheme in the world which aims at providing a health cover of ₹5,00,000/- per family per year.
items.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the production of Azolla in the backyard of farmers for feeding the animals to reduce the concentrate feed cost through easy availability of biomass rich in protein. Through this scheme, the establishment cost of a Cemented Azolla Unit is provided to a farmer.
items.schemeName: Azolla Cultivation in Cemented Pit

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide quality education and holistic development opportunities for girls from backward and extremely backward classes. Free education, accommodation, study material, medical support, and skill development programs are provided.
items.schemeName: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School

items.briefDescription: The BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED) provides early-stage funding through incubators to biotech startups so they can develop their ideas into viable products and launch successful businesses.
items.schemeName: BIRAC Incubator SEED Fund (SEED)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of scholarships to the economically weaker students studying in government engineering and polytechnic colleges of Chhattisgarh.  The scheme offers financial aid to students enrolled in professional courses.
items.schemeName: BPL (Below Poverty Line) Student Welfare Scholarship - Technical Education

items.briefDescription: The scheme “BPL Scholarship For College Students” was implemented by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Chhattisgarh since 2005 to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from BPL category families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
items.schemeName: BPL Scholarship for College Students

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide opportunities to meritorious candidates to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D. degrees in sciences.
items.schemeName: BSR Fellowship Scheme for Science Students - UGC

items.briefDescription: "Back Ended Interest Subsidy" by the Govt of Tamil Nadu, is introduced with the objective of reducing financial burdens of all new micro and small manufacturing enterprises who have already availed loans from banks/ other government organizations by assisting them through a subsidy on term loans.
items.schemeName: Back Ended Interest Subsidy (BEIS)

items.briefDescription: The “Back-to-Lab” programme of Women Scientists Division offers Research and Post-Doctoral Fellowship to women who have break in their career, to facilitate their re-entry in science research.
items.schemeName: Back-To-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme

items.briefDescription: To facilitate the re-entry of women having a career break to Science research, the Kerala State Council of Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE) launched the “Back-to-Lab Research Fellowship Programme” in 2010.
items.schemeName: Back-to-Lab Research Fellowship Programme

items.briefDescription: "Backward Classes Student Merit Award Scheme" aims to recognize and reward academic excellence among backward-class students. Monetary awards are provided to one boy and one girl student from backward classes who secure the highest marks at the district level in class 10th and 12th board exams.
items.schemeName: Backward Class Students Meritorious Award Scheme

items.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2007, the "Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides financial assistance to backward class students for postgraduate, Ph.D., and post-research studies abroad.
items.schemeName: Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote goat rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a goat unit.
items.schemeName: Bakri Palan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Bal Ashrams" have been established by the Social Welfare Dept, Govt. of Jammu and Kashmir, to create a society free from child labor, where all children receive free, compulsory, quality, and meaningful education. Orphans and destitute children are provided free schooling, boarding and lodging.
items.schemeName: Bal Ashrams

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, all babies born to BPL mothers in the State (approximately 3,00,000 births per annum) will be covered for neonatal care by partnering pediatricians, including care in their Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (level 2 ) at no cost to the beneficiary.
items.schemeName: Bal Sakha Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce severe malnutrition and child mortality by providing free institutional care, diet, and medical treatment to severely malnourished children below 5 years of age.
items.schemeName: Bal Shakti Yojana

items.briefDescription: This initiative aims to ensure the survival, healthy growth, and overall well-being of children aged 0–5 years by providing accessible, comprehensive and quality healthcare services.
items.schemeName: Bal Swasthya Karyakram - Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: The Bal-Yuwa Kirtankar Festival is a biannual event organized by the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Goa, aimed at encouraging children and young performers up to 16 years old to promote the traditional art of Kirtan.
items.schemeName: Bal Yuwa Kirtankar Festival

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and reward meritorious girl students of Rajasthan who have performed exceptionally well in their Class 12 examinations.
items.schemeName: Balika Protsahan Yojana (For Class 12th)

items.briefDescription: “Balika Samrithi Yojana” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry was introduced to improve the status of the girl child and provide nutritious food to the girl child. Financial assistance of ₹500 in the form of a National Savings Certificate is provided to lactating mothers.
items.schemeName: Balika Samrithi Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to conserve rainwater in fields to help farmers, ensuring water availability during irrigation and drought conditions. Farmers receive subsidies up to ₹1,00,000/- for pond construction.

items.briefDescription: "Balri Birth Gift Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance in the form of a Fixed Deposit Receipt for the birth of a female child (upto two girls per family) which can be encashed only at the time of the daughter's marriage.
items.schemeName: Balri Birth Gift Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: "Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)" provides financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, helping them build pucca houses with essential amenities. The scheme offers financial assistance with additional support for toilets and unskilled workdays.
items.schemeName: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance to educated unemployed youth of West Bengal to support them until they get employment or join another scheme. The objective is to ensure income support for eligible unemployed youth for a maximum period of 5 years.
items.schemeName: Banglar Yuba Sathi

items.briefDescription: “Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide Interest Subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Commercial Bank to an eligible micro or small enterprise.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)

items.briefDescription: “Power Subsidy (PS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide power subsidy on the electricity consumed for the manufacturing activity to an eligible micro or small enterprise.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Power Subsidy (PS)

items.briefDescription: “State Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Department, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide Capital Investment Subsidy for its approved project to an eligible micro or small enterprise.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: State Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (EES)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement for the cost of energy and installations for energy conservation as per energy audit.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (EES)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred for obtaining Patent Registration.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of the expenditure incurred for obtaining certification from approved Institutions/ Research Laboratories.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide refunds for net SGST paid to the Government of West Bengal.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance” incentives  by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred by it towards the cost of captive Effluent Water Treatment Plant for wastewater recycling and/ or other pollution control devices.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance (WCS)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy for Work Force Welfare Assistance (WWAS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred for paying contribution towards Employees State Insurance (ESI) and Employees Provident.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Work Force Welfare Assistance (WWAS)

items.briefDescription: “Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, provides a reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fee paid by the eligible enterprises for the purpose of registration of documents.
items.schemeName: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)

items.schemeName: Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement Scheme

items.briefDescription: The Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme comes under the purview of the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) of the Government of India.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
items.schemeName: Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme

items.briefDescription: Through the "Bank Tie-Up Scheme", the Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCLDFC) arranges loans through banks, and subsidy is provided by PSCLDFC. items.schemeName: Bank Tie-Up Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to scheduled caste persons for self-employment opportunities. Under this scheme, loans are provided for business, industry, or service activities, along with a subsidy of 50% of the loan amount or a maximum of ₹50,000/-.
items.schemeName: Bankable Scheme

items.briefDescription: The “Barbershop Renovation Grant” scheme is launched by the Backward Communities Development Department, Government of Kerala. items.schemeName: Barbershop Renovation Grant

items.schemeName: Bari (Kitchen Garden) Scheme

items.schemeName: Baristha Nagarika Tirtha Yatra Yojana

items.briefDescription: The 'Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. items.schemeName: Battery Operated Wheelchair by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Bed & Breakfast/Homestay Scheme” is implemented by the Department of Tourism & Cultural Affairs, Government of Punjab with the aim of providing comfortable Bed & Breakfast (BnB)/Home Stay Facilities and supplementing the availability of accommodation across the State.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote beekeeping as a sustainable livelihood by providing subsidized bee boxes, bee colonies, and training support to farmers, thereby increasing honey production, enhancing farm income, and strengthening the beekeeping sector in Uttarakhand.

items.briefDescription: Begum Hazrat Mahal National scholarship is a scholarship scheme also known as Maulana Azad National scholarship scheme was first announced on 3rd May 2003. It is a national level scholarship started for the benefit of the girl’s student belonging to the minority communities.
items.schemeName: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Program

items.briefDescription: 'Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage hearing-impaired students to wear hearing aids to increase their speech capacity.
items.schemeName: Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons

items.briefDescription: The UP government has implemented the UP Unemployment Allowance 2022 scheme in Uttar Pradesh. The government has implemented this scheme only for those candidates who belong to the state and is unemployed despite being educated.

items.briefDescription: Bhagavan Buddha Post SSC Scholarship launched by the Ministry of Education, Government of Gujarat. A scheme was introduced with the aim to encourage SC girl students to continue their higher studies after SSC.

items.briefDescription: The prime goal of this scheme aims to promote the birth of girl children in below poverty line(BPL) families and to raise the status of the girl child in the family in particular and society in general. items.schemeName: Bhagyalaxmi Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognise excellence and outstanding contributions in the Indian steel sector. Through this scheme, awards and incentives are provided to eligible steel companies and individuals.

items.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation (Any course of 2 Years or more duration, after Graduation (10+2+3) will be considered under this category, i.e., M.Sc, M.Com, M.A., M.Tech, M.D., M.Pharm, MBA, etc.)" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education.
items.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation

items.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.
items.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course

items.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. items.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern (IPCC)" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin students.
items.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern

items.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas" aims to provide financial assistance to Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh, who secured admission for any master's degree course overseas in reputed institutions for the year or students pursuing part of their course abroad.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sheep rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a sheep unit.

items.schemeName: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan

items.briefDescription: The "Bhraman-Darshan Yojana" was launched by the Animal and Fisheries Resources Department, Government of Bihar aims to educate fish farmers in Bihar about the latest fisheries techniques through organized excursions, enabling them to adopt and implement these technologies in their water source.....
items.schemeName: Bhraman - Darshan Yojana

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to 5,800 girl students belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS), who are studying in government schools from Class 6 to Class 8, to facilitate their commute between home and school.

items.schemeName: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Accidental Injuries

items.schemeName: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases

items.schemeName: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Natural Death

items.briefDescription: Welfare scheme of Department For The Welfare Of SC/ST/OBC’s/Minorities to provide help for purchase of stationery to SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students of 1st to 12th class studying Govt. of India/GNCT of Delhi/Aided Recognized schools.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Stationery To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- for renovation and special repairs, specifically targeting the purchase of building materials. The intended beneficiaries are Hindu religious institutions situated in Economically Weaker Section Areas or Adi-Dravidar Colonies.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Renovation And Special Repair Works To Hindu Religious Institutions Situated In Economically Weaker Section Areas / Adi-Dravidar Colonies

items.briefDescription: This is a welfare scheme by the GNCTD to provide financial assistance to poor widows for performing the marriage of their daughters and to provide financial assistance to the guardians including Homes/Institutions or foster parents of an orphan girl or an orphan girl for her marriage.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance For The Marriage Of Daughters Of Poor Widows And Orphan Girls

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance on Marriage of Children (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance On Marriage Of Children (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance Scheme for Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination to Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to the dependents of deceased journalists and litterateurs in situations such as medical emergencies, unemployment, or when there is no other source of income.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance Scheme for Dependents of Deceased Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to journalists and litterateurs for the treatment of critical illnesses, medical emergencies and no source of income, unemployment, or advanced age.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance Scheme for Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan

items.briefDescription: The scheme was launched on in the year 1986. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the scheduled castes to purchase agricultural land, with a maximum limit of 2 acres, for self-cultivation.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance Scheme for Purchase of Agricultural Land to Scheduled Caste Farmers

items.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme component is to provide financial assistance to cultural organizations with a national presence to meet the expenditure incurred in conducting cultural programmes and festivals.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Cultural Organizations With National Presence

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide assistance to the Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste communities for the purchase of basic dairy equipments needed to run a small scale dairy farming, and to encourage the tribal population to adopt Animal Husbandry activities, especially Dairy Development Schemes.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Dairy Farmers Belonging To Scheduled Tribes And Scheduled Caste For Purchase Of Basic Dairy Equipments

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance To Dependent Children of Widows And Destitute Women" is a Social Welfare scheme by the Dept. of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Govt. of Chandigarh; to extend financial assistance (₹ 1000/- per month per child) to children who are fatherless or orphan.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Destitute Children Scheme (FADCS)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana in the year 1984.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Destitute Children Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to facilitate the self-employment of unemployed disabled persons. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities for self-employment, small-scale business, and agro-based project. This scheme is 100% funded by Govt. of Maharashtra.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Disabled For Self Employment

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Ex-Convicts” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. This scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice to help those released from jail from poor economic conditions to find their livelihood.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Ex-Convicts

items.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of fisheries requisites (gill nets with accessories).
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Fishermen For Purchase of Fisheries Requisites (Gill Net/ River Gill Net with Accessories)

items.briefDescription: In the "Financial Assistance to Gad-Hanjis", financial assistance for the purchase of Nylon Twine is provided to the Licensed Fisherman by the Social Welfare Department. The beneficiary shall approach the concerned District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) for submission of the application.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Gad-Hanjis

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Institutions/Societies Belonging to Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Institutions/Societies Belonging To Scheduled Castes/Backward Classes

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)

items.briefDescription: Through the “Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme” by the Dept of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of Haryana, financial assistance of ₹1,250/- per month per family member is provided for five years to the Kashmiri families which have migrated from J&K to Haryana.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Kashmiri Migrants Families Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana during the years 2008-09.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme

items.briefDescription: "Financial Assistance to Poor & Needy Widow Women" is a scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt. of Manipur. The objective of the scheme is to provide social security by way of financial assistance to widows in the age group of 18-40 years.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Poor & Needy Widow Women

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to set up pre-primary schools in remote tribal areas, in the form of rent amount payable for the premises, fixed remuneration to one Teacher, one helper, teaching aid/equipment, toys, and mid-meal.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Pre-primary School In Remote Areas

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided to the fishermen of Goa for the purchase of Singel Net/ Small Rampon Net and its accessories.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Purchase Singel Net / Small Rampon Net & Its Accessories

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance to Self-Employment for Trained Disabled Persons" is a scheme by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to facilitate the purchase of equipment for those disabled persons who are completing their vocational training.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Self-Employment For Trained Disabled Persons

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance for the physical & psychological rehabilitation of child victims of communal, caste, ethnic & terrorist violence with special reference to their care, education & training, besides promoting communal harmony,
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under TheNational Foundation For Communal Harmony

items.briefDescription: Financial assistance scheme providing up to ₹36,000 annually to visually challenged permanent college teachers for reader assistance, Braille books, and learning aids. Implemented by University Grants Commission to support teaching, research, and academic independence.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to visually impaired Advocates” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Visually Impaired Advocates

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Women and Girls Acid Attack Victims” by the Govt. of Haryana, provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to the women/girls residing in Haryana who have suffered disfigurement of any part of the body or have become disabled due to acid attack.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Women And Girl Acid Attack Victims

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support or grants to recognized sports associations, clubs, and committees in the state for organizing sports competitions and for purchasing sports equipment for associations and players at the national, state, and district levels.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance and Grants to Sports Associations/ Clubs/ Sports Committees of Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide 50% reimbursement of interest on home loans up to ₹1,00,000 for eligible war widows, war bereaved families, war disabled personnel, and attributable peacetime casualties.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan

items.briefDescription: This scheme was started by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB), Labour Department, Government of Haryana on 15.01.2019. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- will be provided as Shagun for the marriage of workers' sons and unmarried male workers themselves.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance as Shagun in Marriage of Man Workers or Son of Workers - Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide assistance to the youths of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community for training in job-assured technical and professional Diploma and Degree courses. It supports training for courses like ANM, GNM, and Para-Medical, with a minimum duration of one year.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for ANM/GNM/Technical Courses

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for artificial limbs upto rates fixed by Saket Hospital, Chandimandir(Panchkula). This assistance is available to workers employed in industrial &commercial units in Haryana and their dependents, who become disabled due to the loss of vital organs.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Artificial Limbs to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000/- for coaching classes for admission of children of registered workers in professional/technical courses and ₹1,00,000/- for preparation of Main Examination on passing Preliminary Examination of UPSC/HPSSC.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Coaching Classes (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme to provide financial assistance up to ₹20,000/- for coaching of entrance examinations for professional courses and ₹1,00,000/- to the children of workers for preparing for the main examination on passing the preliminary examination of UPSC and HPSC.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Coaching- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹12,000/- to registered construction workers for building toilets. The assistance is disbursed in two installments: the first installment of ₹8,000/- and the second installment of ₹4,000/-.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, 50% of the actual cost of the Wooden/ Fiber-Reinforced Plastic (FRP) Fishing Vessel (Canoe) purchased by the fishermen is covered by the Government of Goa. The applicant will be entitled to a subsidy grant once every four years on one craft per family household.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Construction/ Purchase of Wooden/ FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) for Fishermen

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Cremation" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/-to the dependents of the deceased worker for performing cremation.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Cremation (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹51,000/- per marriage for the marriage of registered construction workers themselves or for the marriage of up to two daughters.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage (UKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Through the "Financial Assistance for Education (GBOCWWB)" scheme, the worker registered with the Board is provided with financial assistance, as determined by the Board, for the education of their children. The applications are accepted offline.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education (GBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The Financial Assistance for Education Scheme has been introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) to provide annual educational assistance for up to two children of a beneficiary, from Class I to professional and research courses.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education (HPBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary" welfare scheme launched by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides one-time financial assistance for the education of children.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker" scheme for education benefit is to give financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers having continuous registration for a period of six months under TBOCWWB.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered member or their children studying Higher Secondary and above.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to fund the pre-matric and post-matric education of wards belonging to specific mine, beedi, and cine workers. It provides annual scholarships between ₹1,000/- and ₹25,000/- based on the student's academic level and course type.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to ₹12,000/- per year is given to the children of workers who are suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education- Haryana Silicosis Board

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the children of the workers working in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for participating in cultural competitions so that the children of the workers can also become good artists.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Cultural Activities- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the children of the workers working in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for participating in sports competitions so that the children of the workers can also become good sportspersons.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Sports Activities- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: The “Financial Assistance for Funeral Expenses” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu and Kashmir, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the nominees of a deceased registered member for covering funeral expenses.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Funeral Expenses (JKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18 scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a fixed deposit of ₹1,00,000/- for each female child of a registered worker or spouse who has undergone a family planning operation after the birth of one female child.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Girl Child Attend Her Age of 18

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. This assistance supports students pursuing higher education like MBBS, MBA, and Engineering, including studies within and outside the State or Country.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Higher Studies

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to the children of construction workers for hostel facilities while they pursue technical/professional courses in recognized institutes.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Hostel Facility in Professional/Technical Institutions (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- is provided to registered male or female workers who have been members of the Board for at least three years, for the marriage of their two adult daughters and for the female member's own marriage.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: "Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)" by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Dept of Labour and Employment, Goa, provides financial assistance of ₹4,000/- for the marriage of the children of the worker who has a continuous membership for 3 years with the Boar
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The Financial Assistance for Marriage scheme under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides ₹51,000/- for the marriage of a registered unmarried beneficiary and ₹51,000/- per child for the marriage of up to two children of a married beneficiary.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage (HPBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme  that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for upto 2 children.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to poor parents from Scheduled Castes for performing the marriage of their daughters.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage of Poor Scheduled Caste Brides

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Medical" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial support for medical expenses, including injury treatment, temporary and permanent disability, and the treatment of chronic diseases.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Medical (JKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The Tamil Development, Religious Endowments, and Information Department scheme was launched by the "Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists". The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to four journalists for medical treatment from the Chief Minister’s Public Relief Fund.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment of Journalists

items.briefDescription: "Financial Assistance for Miscarriage for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides an amount of ₹3,000/- as financial assistance in case of miscarriage.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Miscarriage for the Construction Workers

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Natural Death” was launched by the Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra. Under the scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- to the legal heir of a registered worker who dies.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Natural Death

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide timely financial assistance and relief to individuals and families affected by natural calamities, helping them recover from losses to life, property, and livelihood.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Natural Disaster

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Normal Delivery and Surgical Delivery" scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Normal Delivery and Surgical Delivery

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote youth participation in adventure sports by providing financial assistance for training, workshops, and competitions.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Preparation of Training Camp and Participation in Land, Mountain & Sea Adventure Sports Competitions

items.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions" scheme by the Higher, Technical Education & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides grants to private engineering and polytechnic institutions for infrastructure enhancement and quality education.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions

items.briefDescription: This scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Haryana. Under this scheme, the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories” is a scheme by Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Under this Scheme financial assistance is provided as a subsidy on the purchase of barrier nets and accessories for the fishermen. The applications are accepted offline.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery-Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial support, including an investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt. of India.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to assist the units who are in existence for a minimum period of 2 years with good track record. The assistance is provided for purchase of existing land, building and machinery with prescribed residual life. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Fuel (Petrol) to the Fishermen for Operation of Out Board Motors” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, a subsidy of ₹30 per Litre on a maximum consumption of 1700 Litre of Petrol is provided to fishermen.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Fuel (Petrol) to the Fishermen for Operation of Out Board Motors

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be granted to the workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB for the purchase of Spectacles, Denture and Hearing Aid.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles, Denture, Hearing Aid (CBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of stake nets and accessories for the fishermen.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹50,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) for the purchase or construction of a house, at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance is provided to the children (2 boys & 3 girls) of workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana at the time of admission to continue their studies.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the fisheries co-operative societies/associations registered with the Fisheries Co-operative Societies, having more than 25 members, will be eligible for financial assistance to the extent of ₹50,000 as a grant-in-aid. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Registered Fishermen Society

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World" aims to promote mountaineering by providing financial aid to successful climbers, including up to ₹15,00,000 for those who scale Mt. Everest.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Scaling Mount Everest and Other Inaccessible Mountains of the World

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- is provided to registered women workers for arranging their own marriage who have a minimum one-year regular membership.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Self-Marriage of Registered Women Workers (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to assist the Proprietary/Partnership Concerns, Public/Private Limited Companies, Co-operative Societies, Market Committees, Boards, and Agro Industries Corporations. The assistance is provided for setting up of Cold Storage facilities. The applications for this scheme are online.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Setting Up of Cold Storage

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, financial assistance of 25% of the actual cost, limited to ₹1,50,000 per hectare is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up crab culture unit. Only Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Group/ Societies, interested in the setting up of the Crab Farming Unit.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Setting up Crab Culture Unit

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Stage III & IV Cancer Patients” was launched by the Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, a monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000/- will be provided to Stage III & IV cancer patients of Haryana from 01.01.2024.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Stage III & IV Cancer Patients

items.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Govt. of Bihar. Under this scheme, educational financial support is provided to the children of registered workers who have been members of the Board for at least one year.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Studies (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: This scheme promotes cultural activities across states and fosters unity while providing opportunities for creative expression and learning, especially for the youth.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Tagore Cultural Complexes (TCC)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- is provided to registered workers for indoor treatment of chronic diseases like Cancer, TB, AIDS, etc. as per government rules.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹7,000/- or the actual price, whichever is less, will be provided to workers and their dependents employed in industrial and commercial units of Haryana for purchasing a tricycle if they lose their legs in an accident or due to any other reason.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents - Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to ST and OBC/MOBC students of Assam who have cleared the APSC/UPSC preliminary exam and are appearing for the mains exam in the current year.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for UPSC/APSC Mains Exam

items.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹24,000/- p.a. up to 5 years to the widow or widower in case of death of a registered worker during the course of employment.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Widow or Widower of Registered Construction Worker

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹10,000/- is provided to female workers and wives of male workers working in industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana for the delivery of up to two children (three girls or two boys).
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and preserve the traditional Khell-Tiatr folk musical drama of Goa by promoting quality productions. It offers financial assistance and infrastructure support for staging shows, including video documentation, benefiting dramatic troupes and individuals.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for encouraging production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to the family or dependent of a deceased worker to cover funeral and related expenses. Under this scheme, an assistance amount of ₹15,000/- is provided to the dependent/family of the deceased worker.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for funeral and other activities in case of death of a worker's - Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up Breeding Units and Rearing Units. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa

items.briefDescription: The “Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for education to the children of the registered member of the board for a period of one year or more.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: By the Chandigarh Government, this scheme is initiated to reduce the financial burden for the girl marriage. Under the scheme financial assistance will be provided.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste

items.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance amounting to ₹50% is provided by the Government to eligible fishermen for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Lifejackets and Lifebuoys for Fishermen

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be given to the spouse of registered male construction workers or female construction workers for purchase of sewing machine, once in life time.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Sewing Machine (CBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance for the treatment of ex-servicemen and their dependents (wife & children) who have a disability of 40% or more and are suffering from serious illnesses such as cancer, leprosy, tuberculosis, kidney and cardiac ailments, paralysis, etc.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents (Wife and Children)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹51,000/- is provided to workers employed in the industrial & commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the marriage of their daughters and for the self-marriage of the working women workers as Kanyadaan.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- or the actual cost of the hearing aid, whichever is less, is provided to workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments in the state of Haryana and their dependents for the purchase of a hearing aid machine.
items.schemeName: Financial Assistance of Hearing Machine/Hearing Aid to Workers and their Dependents- Haryana Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided to registered construction workers with full or 50% disability due to an accident. items.briefDescription: The Government of Gujarat provides financial assistance to students belonging to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) who are studying in self-financed medical and engineering colleges/universities.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of food processing units in Uttarakhand, enhance value addition in agricultural and horticultural products, support entrepreneurs with financial assistance, and strengthen the state’s food processing ecosystem.

items.briefDescription: The Internship Program by the FSSAI provides interns with unique learning opportunities in various areas of food regulation of food safety administration. items.schemeName: Food Safety & Standards Authority Of India (FSSAI) Internship Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "Foreign Education Scheme" provides financial assistance for non-reserved category students pursuing higher education abroad after Standard 12.

items.schemeName: Formation Scheme of JHASCOFISH

items.briefDescription: The Foster Care Scheme (Vatsalaya) is being implemented by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa to provide temporary/substitute care for children in difficult circumstances, whose parents are unable to care for them due to illness, death, and desertion of parent, etc.
items.schemeName: Foster Care Scheme (Vatsalaya)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure the availability of blood free of cost to all patients admitted in government hospitals across the state. Under this scheme, blood is provided free of cost by government blood banks to all in-patients who require transfusion during treatment.

items.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. items.schemeName: Free Books Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education

items.briefDescription: "Free Bus Pass for Media Persons" scheme by the Dept of Information & Publicity, Puducherry, aims to provide a free bus pass facility to media persons working in Puducherry in Puducherry Road Transport Corporation buses (except town buses) to undertake journeys for their professional requirements.
items.schemeName: Free Bus Pass for Media Persons

items.briefDescription: The "Free Caste Hostel" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides a scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys and ₹1,270 per month for girls for 10 months.
items.schemeName: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide good coaching quality for DNT candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations and succeed in obtaining an appropriate job in the Public/Private Sector.

items.briefDescription: To provide high-quality free coaching to economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and eligible beneficiaries of the PM CARES Children Scheme for competitive exams in public and private sector employment and admission into professional courses.

items.schemeName: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme

items.briefDescription: A Scheme "Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities" was initiated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the "Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment".

items.schemeName: Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemen, serving soldiers, their widows, and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.

items.briefDescription: The “Free Cycles to SC girl students studying in Standard IX” scheme is administered by the Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat. items.schemeName: Free Cycles to SC Girl Students Studying in Standard IX (Sarasvati Sadhna Yojana)

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Free Distribution of Blankets and Chappals to Senior Citizen" was launched by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. items.schemeName: Free Distribution of Blankets and Chappals to Senior Citizen

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to distribute 15 Kg of rice per month or equivalent Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the differently abled persons.
items.schemeName: Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons

items.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2008, the scheme "Free Distribution of Textbooks to Students" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free textbooks to students studying in classes 9th to 12th in government schools.

items.briefDescription: The scheme of "Free Education for Sports Medal Winners / Participants of National/ International Events" is introduced by UGC, to provide financial assistance to the medal winners\ elite sports persons studying in universities/colleges leading to all the full-time regular courses.

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support to Backward, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities students pursuing 3-year undergraduate courses (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.) in Government and Government Aided Arts and Science Colleges.

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides full coverage of tuition fees, special fees, and examination fees for Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) students pursuing professional courses.
items.schemeName: Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses (Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, Veterinary, and Law)

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides free education scholarships for students from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities pursuing 3-year Diploma courses in Government and Government-Aided Polytechnics.

items.briefDescription: "Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class" aims to provide quality pre-examination training for various employment-oriented competitive examinations to talented but economically disadvantaged young men and women.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free legal aid to all eligible persons in Uttarakhand who intend to file a case, have already filed a case, or need to defend a case under the provisions of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.
items.schemeName: Free Legal Aid under the Legal Services Authority Act 1987

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides free medical facilities to press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration. items.schemeName: Free Medical Card for Media Persons

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities”, who are facing the mainstream of society due to their disabilities are provided motorized tricycles free of cost to those unable to connect.

items.schemeName: Free Supply of Rice to the Poor People

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free textbooks every year to all students studying in Classes 1 to 8, irrespective of their social category.
items.schemeName: Free Text Book Distribution

items.schemeName: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility to eligible candidates appearing in interviews of competitive examinations conducted by UPSC, RPSC, and RSMSSN by enabling cost-free journey through Rajasthan State Transport Corporation services.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to armed forces personnel and recipients of gallantry medals.

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facility in Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation buses to mentally challenged persons along with one companion.
