The main focus of GOBARDHAN is to keep villages clean.
items.schemeName: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan)

items.briefDescription: The "Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the government of Uttar Pradesh, India, to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers for the  treatment from the serious Illness
items.schemeName: Gambhir Bimari Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: The Government of Uttar Pradesh initiated a scheme "Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi Shramik Puraskar Raschi Yojana" to encourage the children towards the education.
items.schemeName: Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to widowed women, ensuring self-reliance through monthly pensions.
items.schemeName: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme supports remarried women who are beneficiaries of the Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme, aiming to reintegrate them into society with financial support.
items.schemeName: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme

items.briefDescription: MP Gaon Ki Beti Yojna 2022-23 is a scholarship provided by the Madhya Pradesh government. The MP state government has started this scheme to encourage the higher education of girl children in remote areas in 2005.
items.schemeName: Gaon Ki Beti

items.briefDescription: The benefit of Gargi Puraskar Yojana is given every year to the beneficiary girl child of Rajasthan on the day of Basant Panchami. This time also the beneficiary girl students were taken on a tour of the girl students on the occasion of Basant Panchami very year.
items.schemeName: Gargi Puruskar Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate girl students studying in Classes 6 to 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state by providing financial scholarships to support their education.
items.schemeName: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana

items.briefDescription: The aims to provide shelter, protection, rehabilitation, livelihood opportunities, and social reintegration support to transgender persons. It also provides shelter facilities, food, medical care, counselling, legal assistance, skill development, and document support to transgender persons.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Gatidhara Scheme” was launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal in August 2014 for employment of registered unemployed youth of the State in the transport sector.
items.schemeName: Gatidhara Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote cow rearing among eligible Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries, enhancing their livelihood and income generation by providing financial support for cow rearing units.
items.schemeName: Gau Palan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The objective of scheme is to prevent crimes against women & girls and to ensure prompt action in case of any incident. Under this, a three-tier support system is set up with Mahila Desks at police stations,Women Safety Helpline & Counselling Cells at district level, & a State Women Safety Helpline.
items.schemeName: Gaura Shakti Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Gaurav Puraskar Award" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to honour artistes for their significant achievements in music, dance, drama, and folk art by providing a cash award, trophy, and appreciation letter.
items.schemeName: Gaurav Puraskar Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)" aims to empower educated unemployed rural youth with self-employment opportunities and the skills to provide primary veterinary services in remote rural areas. A 100% stipend of ₹6,000 for initial training and ₹500 for refresher training.
items.schemeName: Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote installation of biogas plants in registered gaushalas to generate renewable energy, increase income, and support organic farming.
items.schemeName: Gaushala Biogas Sahbhagita Yojna

items.briefDescription: This initiative provides financial assistance to registered gaushalas for building permanent infrastructure. Under this scheme, up to ₹10,000,00/- can be provided, with 90% of the funding from the state government and 10% contributed by the gaushala.
items.schemeName: Gaushala Vikas Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence" scheme aims to provide awards to the topper of the recognized and reputed School/ College/ Institute for his/her academic excellence in SSC/ Intermediate or equivalent/ Graduation/ Professional Education Course for the Academic year.
items.schemeName: Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence

items.briefDescription: The "Gen Next Competition" scheme was launched by the Department of Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles & Khadi, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. A craft competition was started from the year 2013-2014 to encourage the youth to retain the traditional handicrafts of Tamil Nadu & pass them on to the next generation.
items.schemeName: Gen Next Competition

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a pension shall be given to a registered beneficiary working as a building worker for not less than one year after the commencement of the Rules on completion of sixty years of age.
items.schemeName: General Pension (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Classes 6 to 8 in government schools. Students whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category are eligible for the benefits.
items.schemeName: General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)

items.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship for General category students. This scholarship aims to financially assist students from these categories to pursue secondary education and complete their matriculation.
items.schemeName: General Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh

items.briefDescription: The "General Surgery Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for general surgery of the beneficiary and his family members.
items.schemeName: General Surgery Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Generator Subsidy" is introduced with the objective of assisting all new and existing Micro, Small, and Medium Manufacturing Enterprises through a subsidy of 25% on the cost of the generator purchased (up to 320 KVA capacity), subject to a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000.
items.schemeName: Generator Subsidy

items.briefDescription: The “Generator Subsidy” scheme provides a 25% subsidy on the cost of generator sets up to 125 KVA capacity for manufacturers in Tamil Nadu.
items.schemeName: Generator Subsidy-Tamil Nadu

items.briefDescription: Rajasthan government has planned a new scheme called Rajasthan Ghar Ghar Aushadhi Yojana to promote the use of Ayurvedic and medicinal herbs across the state.
items.schemeName: Ghar Ghar Aushodhi Yojana

items.briefDescription: Gharaunda (Group Home for Adults) scheme aims at setting up Gharaunda Centres or Registered Organisations (RO) for for all Adult PwDs covered under the National Trust Act with adequate and quality care service with acceptable living standards including provision of basic medical care from profession
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: Gharaunda-Group Home for Adults Scheme

items.briefDescription: The Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Gharelu Hinsa Peedit Ke Liye Sahayta" Yojana for victims of domestic violence in Madhya Pradesh, offering various types of assistance including financial aid, legal support, and shelter.
items.schemeName: Gharelu Hinsa Ki Pidita Ke Liye Sahayta Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.
items.schemeName: Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to eradicate malnutrition by providing free nutritional supplements like ghee, oil, and dal to Sahariya and Kherua families in Baran district.
items.schemeName: Ghee, Oil and Dal Distribution to Sahariya and Kheruya Family

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote girls' education in the state by providing financial assistance for the purchase of bicycles to girl students studying in Class 9 in government and government-aided secondary schools.
items.schemeName: Girl Education Promotion (Bicycle Scheme)

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme” was announced by the Department of School Education, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh in 2013 for the girl students studying in classes 6-12. The scheme's focus was to retain, maintain hygiene, and continue education throughout the year.
items.schemeName: Girl Students Health & Hygiene Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Madhya Pradesh Government encourages girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities to study. Girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time receive ₹3,000/-
items.schemeName: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Girnar Arohan-Avrohan Competition” by the Department of Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities aims to promote physical fitness and competitive spirit among citizens through a state-level stair-climbing competition on Mount Girnar, offering cash prizes to the top 10 winners.
items.schemeName: Girnar Arohan-Avrohan Competition

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide housing for the Economically Weaker Sections of people who do not own a pucca house. Through this scheme, dwelling units are provided to poor people in rural and urban areas, and those affected by calamities or government projects.
items.schemeName: Gitanjali Housing Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide artists practising Indian art forms with an opportunity to perform abroad. Funding for international travel, performance opportunities, and logistical support is provided to Indian artists, dancers, musicians, and cultural troupes selected for performance abroad.
items.schemeName: Global Engagement Scheme: Festival of India

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to generate a greater understanding of India's culture and foster closer friendship with people of other countries. Through this component, financial grants are provided to Indo-Foreign Friendship/Cultural Societies actively functioning in foreign countries.
items.schemeName: Global Engagement Scheme: Grant-In-Aid To Indo-Foreign Friendship Cultural Societies

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to encourage Labourers/Industrial Workers to purchase of battery operated electric two-wheelers that reduce carbon emissions.
items.schemeName: Go Green Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of electric two-wheelers to construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.
items.schemeName: Go-Green Shramik Scheme (GBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of battery-operated tricycle (e-rickshaw) vehicles to registered construction disabled workers. Also, assistance will be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time of the new Three-Wheeler.
items.schemeName: Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme (GBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage Goan artisans to continue traditional clay idol making by providing a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol, supporting registered local craftsmen in preserving cultural heritage and ensuring livelihood sustainability.
items.schemeName: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodies.
items.schemeName: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)

items.briefDescription: The Goa Festival in Other States promotes Goa artistes by providing them a platform to perform outside Goa. Participants are recommended by Kala Academy’s Advisory Committees and receive an honorarium as approved.
items.schemeName: Goa Festival In Other States

items.briefDescription: “Goa Mediclaim Scheme” provides financial assistance to avail super-speciality treatments that are not available in the Government Hospitals of Goa, such as dialysis, plastic surgery, ICU care, angiography and angioplasty, open-heart surgery, kidney transplantation, neurosurgery, etc.
items.schemeName: Goa Mediclaim Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost self-employment in Goa and subsidize Capital Investment to encourage the creation of fixed assets. The scheme provides a 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment to individuals, partnership firms, or groups of individuals who have availed loans for approved self-employment.
items.schemeName: Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed to envisage grant of awards for one meritorious Library and one Librarian serving either in any Government or Government–aided Libraries in the State of Goa, which includes the Public/Academic/Special/Research Libraries.
items.schemeName: Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award

items.briefDescription: "Goa State Cultural Award" has been designed to honour the eminent personalities in the field of Art and culture. The scheme intends to give recognition to the Goan artists par excellence for their lifetime achievements and for their extraordinary contribution to the field of Art and culture in Goa.
items.schemeName: Goa State Cultural Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Cultural Award for Institution" by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa is designed to recognize, promote and appreciate the contribution of the institution in the field of Art and culture. This will give a tremendous boost to cultural institutions in Goa.
items.schemeName: Goa State Cultural Award for Institution

items.briefDescription: "Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008" aimed to promote industrial growth, revive sick units, and provide employment to local youths. Additional subsidies and incentives were given to eligible manufacturing units, with a focus on local employment and industrial development.
items.schemeName: Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Export Market Development Scheme" encouraged Goan industries to improve export markets and support them in establishing their goods firmly in the export market. It provided interest-free loans up to ₹5,00,000/- for participating in exhibitions and market study tours abroad.
items.schemeName: Goa State Export Market Development Scheme, 2008

items.briefDescription: "Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme" aimed to encourage industrial units to obtain certifications and patents for quality standards. It provided financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000/- to eligible industries and service sectors.
items.schemeName: Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme, 2008

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides reimbursement of 50% of the cost incurred for skill upgradation and training manpower, limited to a maximum of ₹5,000/- per person employed in the Entity. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC).
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Skill Development

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance by reimbursing Stamp Duty and Registration Charges paid by prospective developers engaged in the establishment of Logistics and Warehousing projects. The scheme provides 100% reimbursement, capped at ₹10,00,000/- for Stamp Duty.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Charges

items.briefDescription: The subsidy aims to support the logistics and warehousing sector by reimbursing 50% of the annual interest paid on construction loans. The benefit is capped at ₹25,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs) annually per project and is available for up to 05 consecutive years for eligible entities.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. This component offers a 100% annual reimbursement of electricity duty, up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000/-, to eligible Cold Chain Units.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Electricity Duty

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for developing the logistics and warehousing industry in Goa. It offers a capital subsidy of 10% or 15% (up to ₹50,00,000/- yearly) towards fixed asset investment for eligible logistics and warehousing entities.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance operational efficiency in logistics and warehousing by subsidizing the cost of purchasing and installing Logistics Management Software. Eligible entities can receive a one-time reimbursement of 50% of the expenditure, capped at ₹2,00,000/- per installation.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Logistics Management Software

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support environmentally sustainable industrial development while accelerating investment in Goa. The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement equal to 50% of the expenses incurred for establishing a Quality Management System, capped at ₹5,00,000/- per Entity.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Quality

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial allowance for upgrading transportation infrastructure by installing tracking devices on goods carriers. It offers a reimbursement of 50% of the installation expenditure, capped at ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per device, to eligible entities.
items.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Transportation through Tracking Devices

items.briefDescription: "Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" aims to improve the welfare of working journalists retired from service in Goa and their families. It provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family pension benefits for eligible journalists and their dependents.
items.schemeName: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme

items.briefDescription: The “Goa Statehood Day Programme ” is a cultural programme under the Art, Culture, and Museums Department, Goa, to celebrate Goa Statehood Day on 30th May every year by organising classical dance and music concerts featuring reputed artistes or groups of artistes.
items.schemeName: Goa Statehood Day Programme

items.briefDescription: "Goa Traditional Bakers (Poders) Subsidy Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to traditional bakers (poders) in Goa to ensure the protection and growth of this traditional occupation. Subsidies for the purchase of flour are provided to traditional bakers who produce essential Goan breads.
items.schemeName: Goa Traditional Bakers (Poders) Subsidy Scheme

items.briefDescription: "Goa Tribal’s Employment Generation Programme Scheme" provides a subsidy of 40% on the total loan amount i.e. 95% of the project cost. The scheme is for educated unemployed individuals in the 18 to 45 years age group who are members of the tribal communities of Goa.
items.schemeName: Goa Tribal's Employment Generation Programme Scheme

items.briefDescription: “Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, the amount equivalent to the actual VAT paid shall be reimbursed to the owner as a subsidy on H.S.D. Oil consumed by the fishing vessel.
items.schemeName: Goa Value Added Tax-Based Subsidy on H.S.D. Oil Consumed by Fishing Vessels Scheme

items.briefDescription: GVMCCGS awards the Panchayats / Municipal Local Bodies to discuss and resolve the issues relating to children. The winner is awarded an annual financial grant of ₹ 10,000/- towards administrative expenses incurred on organizing the activities of the Committee.
items.schemeName: Goa Village & Municipal Child Committee Grants And Awards Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers" by the Home Department, Government of Goa, provides financial assistance in the form of a Gross Pension of ₹ 2,500/- per month to the beneficiaries. The applicant should be a retired seaman. The age of the applicant should be 60 years or above.
items.schemeName: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase the income and raise the living standards of tribal women beneficiaries. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for setting up goat units.
items.schemeName: Goat Rearing Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support through grants and bank loans to farmers to purchase (10+1) goat units for milk and meat production. The scheme covers a 40% subsidy for general applicants and 60% for SC/ST beneficiaries, based on a total unit cost of ₹77,456/-.
items.schemeName: Goat Unit Scheme On Grants And Bank Loans

items.briefDescription: Godhan Nyay Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Chhattisgarh on 20 July 2020. Under this scheme, cow dung will be purchased by the state government from the cattle-rearing farmers.
items.schemeName: Godhan Nyay Yojana

items.briefDescription: The 'Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute goggles to needy visually impaired persons to enable them to protect themselves from sunlight.
items.schemeName: Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students who have passed Class 12 and secured admission through National Level Entrance Exams. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible APST students and other students from Arunachal Pradesh admitted to premier national institutions.
items.schemeName: Golden Jubilee Merit Awards

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Gomant Vibhushan Award" has been designed in order to honour and recognize the Goan renowned personalities who have contributed to the distinguished and extraordinary achievements/ services in any field of activities/disciplines such as art & culture, literature & education, sports, etc.
items.schemeName: Gomant Vibhushan Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the conservation and rearing of Local Breeds of Cattle in the State of Goa. It provides financial assistance of ₹80/- per animal per day to Dairy Farmers or Individuals who are bonafide residents of Goa to encourage responsible stall feeding and conservation practices.
items.schemeName: Gomantak Govsamvardhan Yojana

items.briefDescription: Launched on 3rd Oct 2021 by the MoRTH, the scheme grants an award to the good samaritan who has saved the life of a victim of a fatal accident (involving a motor vehicle) by administering immediate assistance and rushing to the Hospital/Trauma Care Centre within the Golden Hour of the accident.
items.schemeName: Good Samaritan Scheme

items.briefDescription: The “Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana” was launched by the Information & Public Relations Department, Govt. of Odisha. It is a health insurance scheme that covers the medical expenses of the journalists and their eligible family members.
items.schemeName: Gopabandhu Sambadika Swasthya Bima Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana" scheme was launched as an endeavor to make higher education inclusive and to increase the gross enrollment ratio. The scheme aims to further widen access to higher education for students belonging to underprivileged sections of society.
items.schemeName: Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Gopal Incentive Scheme" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, promotes the rearing of Indian high-breed cattle and boosts milk production, benefiting animal breeders and livestock farmers with access to Indian advanced breed cows.
items.schemeName: Gopal Incentive Scheme

items.briefDescription: "Gopal Ratna Award Scheme" intends to appreciate the achievement of Dairy Farmers for the highest individual milk production by undertaking scientific Dairy Farming in the State of Goa and encouraging youth to take up the Dairy Business.
items.schemeName: Gopal Ratna Award Scheme

items.briefDescription: In order to give financial support to the aggrieved family members of the ill-fated farmers the State Govt. has provided accident claim cover through Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Audhan Yojana in the year 2023-24.
items.schemeName: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Audhan Yojana
items.schemeShortTitle: GOPINATH MUNDE SHETKARI APGHAT SURAKSHA SANUGRAH AUDHAN YOJANA

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide specialized education and skill development in food processing, canning, bakery, confectionery, and cookery to students from Uttarakhand, empowering them with technical knowledge and practical expertise to pursue careers in the food industry and promote entrepreneurship.
items.schemeName: Government Food Science Training Centre

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide tourists an opportunity to experience unique stays at government guest houses located at scenic and eco-tourism destinations across Rajasthan at affordable prices.
items.schemeName: Government Guest House Scheme for Tourists

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide suitable, inexpensive, and safe accommodation to women employed in government offices, organizations, and firms, as well as girl students studying in colleges. Essential facilities include a cot with mattress, lockable cupboards, television, newspapers, magazines, etc.
items.schemeName: Government Hostel for Working Women/ Girl Students

items.briefDescription: The 'Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded,Chennai' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, children with intellectual disability are given special education, vocational training, food, uniforms etc.
items.schemeName: Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded - Tamil Nadu

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to arrange for education and rehabilitation of children with disabilities by providing them free hostel, education-training, food, clothing and residential facilities.
items.schemeName: Government Institutions for Teaching and Training of Persons with Disabilities

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Government Service Home" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide institutional care to widows, destitute women, deserted women, adolescent girls and differently-abled women and their children.
items.schemeName: Government Service Home - Tamil Nadu

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, was introduced to facilitate the education and self-confidence development of visually impaired and hearing-impaired children.
items.schemeName: Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Government Working Women’s Hostel" is an initiative by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide safe accommodation facilities to working women who live far away from their families, belonging to lower and middle-income groups.
items.schemeName: Government Working Women’s Hostel

items.briefDescription: The scheme supports NDA cadets from humble financial backgrounds undergoing training at NDA. The scheme aims to attract cadets from economically disadvantaged sections of society opting to serve the country by taking up such challenging jobs/training.
items.schemeName: Government of Goa State Scholarship to NDA Cadets

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage educated youth among the citizens of India and bonafide residents of Mizoram who aspire to succeed entry to Central and All India Services, addressing the issue of Mizo educated youths lagging behind and becoming increasingly marginalized in examinations.
items.schemeName: Government of Mizoram Incentive Cash Award Scheme To Successful Candidates for Central and All India Service Examination

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide infrastructure facilities at village level to artisans through Common Facility Centers. Registered Non-Governmental Organizations, cooperative societies and trusts receive financial assistance up to ₹13,00,000/- for building infrastructure, training, equipment, etc.
items.schemeName: Gramodhyog Vikas Kendra

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide annual financial assistance to Hindu Religious Institutions situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry that have poor resources. It benefits the temple authorities by covering expenses associated with the performance of Oru Kala Pooja, Current Consumption Charges, etc.
items.schemeName: Grant For Oru Kala Pooja

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant for Purchase of Tools (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.
items.schemeName: Grant For Purchase Of Tools (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide boarding and lodging facilities to tribal students who wish to pursue primary, secondary and higher secondary education. Free lodging and boarding facilities are provided to intended beneficiaries who are students studying in standards 5th to 12th.
items.schemeName: Grant In Aid Hostels

items.briefDescription: The "Grant in Aid to Old Age Home" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, grants are provided to the NGOs for accommodating old men & women, destitute, disabled victims, into Old Age Homes, and providing them with food, & accommodation.
items.schemeName: Grant In Aid To Old Age Home

items.briefDescription: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Grant Of Financial Assistance For The Funeral Expenses Of Old Age/Destitute Pensioner Scheme to extend a helping hand by way of monthly financial assistance to Old Age/Destitute Pensioners.
items.schemeName: Grant Of Financial Assistance For The Funeral Expenses Of Old Age/ Destitute Pensioner

items.briefDescription: “Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons” by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry supports marriages between differently-abled individuals and those without disabilities. An incentive of ₹1,00,000/- is provided (₹20,000 as cash, and ₹80 as NSC).
items.schemeName: Grant Of Incentive For Marriage Between Differently Abled Person And Normal Persons

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste Girls Students to pursue their studies in Primary Education. Because of this assistance, the parents of those students may not lose any income that they would otherwise get by sending their girls to work.
items.schemeName: Grant Of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage farmers to adopt the cultivation of commercially valuable aromatic crops such as lemongrass, citronella, palmarosa, khus, damask rose, mint (except Japanese mint), geranium, black cumin, rosemary, bay leaf, timur & sandalwood by providing financial assistance to them.
items.schemeName: Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants - Centre for Aromatic Plants

items.briefDescription: “Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme” is for the educational institutes in Goa, affiliated with a recognized public university. They can avail of a one-time grant towards capital expenses for setting up an incubator within their institute campuses.
items.schemeName: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a grant of ₹50,000/- per daughter to Scheduled Caste families, for a maximum of two daughters, whose total monthly family income from all sources does not exceed ₹4,000/- or who belong to a BPL family, to help cover marriage expenses.
items.schemeName: Grant for Marriage of Daughters of Scheduled Caste Individuals

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a grant of up to ₹3,500/- is provided for the purchase of individual aids, which may be increased to a maximum of ₹7,000/- in special cases. Additionally, ₹500/- is provided for the repair of prosthetic limbs and other assistive equipment.
items.schemeName: Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities

items.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹3,500/- is provided to registered construction workers who have been members of the Board for at least one year, for purchasing a bicycle.
items.schemeName: Grant for Purchase of Bicycle (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this scheme, registered construction workers who have completed skill upgradation training are provided financial assistance of upto ₹15,000/- for purchasing trade-related tools.
items.schemeName: Grant for Purchase of Tools (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote breed improvement and increase milk production by encouraging the use of sex-sorted semen for artificial insemination in cows and buffaloes.
items.schemeName: Grant for Sex-Sorted Semen to Livestock Farmers

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per daughter for the marriage of up to two daughters of destitute widows who are receiving widow pension and whose total monthly income from all sources does not exceed ₹4,000/-, or who belong to BPL families.
items.schemeName: Grant for the Marriage of Daughter of Destitute Widow

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for purchasing work-related tools. Through this scheme, a grant is provided to eligible members of the Fund.
items.schemeName: Grant for the Purchase of Work Related Tools for the Construction Workers

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools” by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides one-time reimbursement to each registered beneficiary of the Board for purchasing tools.
items.schemeName: Grant for the Purchase of Working Tools (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to registered workers who have been members of the Board for at least three years for repair of house. However, workers who have already received assistance for house construction, bicycles, or tools are not eligible for this benefit.
items.schemeName: Grant for the Repair of House (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families/dependents of individuals who lose their lives due to any disaster. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹4,00,000/- is given as ex-gratia to support the affected families.
items.schemeName: Grant in Case of Death Due to Disaster

items.briefDescription: "Grant of 50% Subsidy for the Purchase of Aquarium and Its Accessories" is introduced with the objective to propagate the importance of aquarium keeping and to inculcate the art of aquarium keeping among the general public. The scheme is extended to all the regions of Puducherry.
items.schemeName: Grant of 50% Subsidy for the Purchase of Aquarium and Its Accessories under "Development of Freshwater Aquaculture and Setting up of Aquarium, Ornamental Fish Breeding Centre"

items.briefDescription: "Grant of Annual Scholarship to the Students Belonging to UT of Puducherry Selected and Studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Directorate of School Education, Puducherry. A scholarship of ₹10,000/- per annum per student is provided.
items.schemeName: Grant of Annual Scholarship to the Students Belonging to UT of Puducherry Selected and Studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to poor brides living below the poverty line to meet their marriage expenses. The assistance amount is ₹25,000, and it is granted for the first marriage of the bride. The scheme is implemented through the Department of Women and Child Development.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Marriage of Poor Brides Living Below Poverty Line

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the children of industrial workers/employees, studying in classes 1st to 4th in recognized/approved schools are provided financial assistance for the purchase of textbooks/notebooks. The scheme aims to provide financial support for the educational needs of the children.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide monthly financial assistance to Persons with Disability to maintain their minimum standard of living.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste Pregnant & Lactating Women” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance for the well-being of Pregnant and Lactating mothers and their children.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste Pregnant & Lactating Women

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage APST youth to pursue commercial pilot training. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible APST students enrolled in DGCA-approved Commercial Pilot License courses.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to the APST Youth for pursuing and obtaining "Commercial Pilot License Course"

items.briefDescription: This scheme was introduced to promote small family norms, uplift the welfare of girl children, and ease the financial burden on parents during their daughter's marriage. The scheme provides ₹25,000/- financial assistance for single girl children studying in 8th to 10th standard.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Grant of Financial Assistance to the Press Reporters of Puducherry" by the Department of Information & Publicity, Union Territory of Puducherry, aims to provide financial support amounting to ₹25,000/- to eligible press reporters who have served in registered Newspapers/Magazines.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Press Reporters of Puducherry

items.briefDescription: "Grant of Financial Assistance to the School-going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform" by the Dept of Labour & Employment, Goa, aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of uniforms to school-going children.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to the School Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote tourism infrastructure by providing financial incentives to hotels, resorts, heritage hotels, and other tourism projects. The scheme offers capital grants and subsidies to eligible applicants who have invested in and developed tourism-related projects.
items.schemeName: Grant of Financial Incentives for Hotels, Resorts, and Tourism Projects

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Fuel Subsidy to Differently Abled Persons Who Are Owning Motorised Vehicles” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry was introduced to provide a subsidy of upto 50 % of the cost of fuel to persons with disability who own motorised vehicles.
items.schemeName: Grant of Fuel Subsidy to Differently Abled Persons Who Are Owning Motorised Vehicles

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The poor Scheduled Caste people, and other Economically backward class people, who meet the eligibility criteria, are provided house construction subsidy.
items.schemeName: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, an incentive of ₹2,00,000/- is provided, comprising ₹40,000 in cash and ₹1,60,000/- in the form of a National Savings Certificate (NSC), for the marriage between differently-abled individuals. The selection is periodical and depends on the availability of funds.
items.schemeName: Grant of Incentive for Marriage Between Differently Abled Person

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to create awareness among parents about the desirability of the girl child and elevate the status of the girl child in the family. The scheme provides an amount of ₹30,000/- deposited in the name of the girl child, and in the case of two girl children, ₹15,000/- is deposited.
items.schemeName: Grant of Incentive to the Family having One Girl/Two Girl Children and Parents who have undergone Family Planning

items.briefDescription: “Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to motivate the Scheduled Caste people to keep their houses neat and tidy. Incentives are in the form of household articles worth ₹500/-.
items.schemeName: Grant of Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Award for Clean Houses

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide financial support to widows for the marriage of their daughters. Eligible widows can receive ₹25,000/- to cover marriage expenses. The scheme is implemented through the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry.
items.schemeName: Grant of Marriage Allowance to the Widow's Daughter

items.briefDescription: "Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges"reimburses payments made to Consultancy and certification agencies towards acquiring such Quality Certification subject to a ceiling of ₹ 2,00,000/- for National level certification and ₹ 10,00,000/- for International level Certification.
items.schemeName: Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges

items.briefDescription: "Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees" by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry was introduced to provide financial assistance to differently abled individuals undergoing technical or professional training. The objective is to enable them to successfully complete their training.
items.schemeName: Grant of Stipend to Differently Abled Trainees

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance to young Junior Advocates in the Union territory of Puducherry. The benefit is a stipend of ₹5,000/- per month for up to two years offered to eligible Law Graduates who are citizens and residents of Puducherry.
items.schemeName: Grant of Stipend to Junior Advocates Scheme

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the differently abled persons undergoing any technical or professional training through Institutes are paid a fixed monthly stipend which will enable them to secure the training successfully in order to make their own earnings and become useful members of the society.
items.schemeName: Grant of Stipend to the Differently Abled Trainees of the Vocational Training Institutes

items.briefDescription: "Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students" scheme aims to improve the educational status of handicapped children studying in standards 1st to 10th. Monthly stipends (₹200 to ₹300) are provided to parents who are unable to send their children to school due to economic reasons.
items.schemeName: Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to preserve fish and fishery products by facilitating the establishment of Ice Plant-cum-Cold Storage Units and Fish Processing Units. Through this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can avail a 10% subsidy.
items.schemeName: Grant of Subsidy For Setting up of Ice-Plant /Cold Storage/Fish Processing Unit

items.briefDescription: "Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle" aims to facilitate the quick transportation of fish catches from landing centers to marketing places, thereby preventing/minimizing spoilage of fish. It provides a 50% subsidy for the procurement of specified vehicles.
items.schemeName: Grant of Subsidy for Procurement of Vehicle

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a subsidy for the purchase or conversion of Electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and four-wheelers, along with scrapping incentives for old vehicles, incentives for local manufacturing in Goa, and low-cost loans provided by CESL.
items.schemeName: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of 'Electric Vehicles' to Consumers in State of Goa

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to provide Financial Assistance of ₹ 2,500/- to the Bridegroom from Weaker Section.
items.schemeName: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mangalyam to the Bridegroom of Weaker Section

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide the beneficiary with a mobile seafood van. This van, financed through a combination of bank loan and departmental subsidy (25% and 75%, respectively), is intended for the sale of fresh and processed fish and fishery products in areas not served by regular markets.
items.schemeName: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mobile Sea Food Van

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. In this scheme, a fixed sum ₹ 300/- per month shall be paid as Transport Allowance to the differently abled individuals.
items.schemeName: Grant of Transport Allowance to Differently Abled Persons

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a grant of ₹15,000/- is provided from the Amalgamated Fund to the children of ex-servicemen who pass the written examination of CDS, NDA, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy, for the purpose of coaching.
items.schemeName: Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces

items.briefDescription: The policy aims to promote film production in Uttarakhand by providing financial grants to films, TV serials, and web series shot in the state, encouraging filmmakers to showcase Uttarakhand’s culture, heritage, and locations, and boosting local employment and the state's film economy.
items.schemeName: Grant to Films

items.briefDescription: The "Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions" scheme by the Department of School Education and Literacy, Jharkhand Government provides financial assistance to unaided educational institutions for infrastructure and educational development.
items.schemeName: Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions

items.briefDescription: "Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level" is a Welfare Scheme by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The meritorious wards of the ESM are provided grants for their achievements in sports at national and international levels. The application is offline.
items.schemeName: Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level (Sainik Welfare)

items.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the academically meritorious wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM who have secured the top three ranks in academics are provided with lump sum grants of upto ₹18,000. The application should be submitted within three months from the date of publication of the result.
items.schemeName: Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)

items.briefDescription: "Grant-in-aid to Voluntary Organizations Working in the Area of Disabled Welfare" aims to support institutions working for the welfare of disabled individuals. Grants for free education, training, residential arrangements, and rehabilitation are provided to disabled immigrants.
items.schemeName: Grant-In-Aid to Voluntary Organizations Working In The Area of ​​Disabled Welfare

items.briefDescription: The SWAWLAMBHAN Scheme by the Govt. of Goa provides financial assistance to Mahila Mandals/Self-Help Groups for training/orientation for members of the Mahila Mandal/Self-Help Groups for generating their own activity for self-employment.
items.schemeName: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN)

items.briefDescription: "Grant-in-Aid Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Mahila Mandals" aims to provide financial assistance to Mahila Mandals for training and self-employment activities. The scheme benefits registered Mahila Mandals in Goa, encouraging women's socio-economic development.
items.schemeName: Grant-in-Aid Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Mahila Mandals

items.briefDescription: “Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence" was launched by Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. NGOs are paid ₹ 500/- per month per inmates, in two equal installments, for 12 months.
items.schemeName: Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence

items.briefDescription: State Government is granting financial assistance in the form of Grant-in-Aid to a person having no employment under the Government, Public Sector undertaking, or under any local bodies may qualify to receive the grand suffering from fell disease.
items.schemeName: Grant-in-aid (TB)

items.briefDescription: "Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings" was introduced by the Directorate of Education, Goa. items.schemeName: Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for fodder and water to registered Gaushalas and Kanji Houses in Rajasthan. It ensures the conservation and promotion of cattle by supporting their daily maintenance costs.
items.schemeName: Grant-in-aid to Gaushalas

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Grant-in-aid to Non-governmental Organisations" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The objective of this scheme is to cover 90% of estimated maintenance cost for the registered NGOs running residential homes for children, aged, and vulnerable.....
items.schemeName: Grant-in-aid to Non-governmental Organisations

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance in the form of one-time grants to patients undergoing medical treatment in connection with T.B., Cancer and other malignant diseases. This scheme provides one-time financial assistance to patients belonging to the Tea Tribes community.
items.schemeName: Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases

items.briefDescription: The aims to promote sustainable tourism development in the state by encouraging private and institutional investment in the tourism sector through targeted financial incentives and subsidies.
items.schemeName: Grants Provisioned under Uttarakhand Tourism Policy, 2023

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for medical treatment to patients suffering from Tuberculosis, Cancer, and other major diseases. It provides a one-time financial grant to patients of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community.

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides a grant of ₹20,00,000–₹12,000 and a monthly allowance of ₹5,000–₹1,500 to gallantry awardees as a mark of honor and recognition for their valor.
items.schemeName: Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations

items.briefDescription: Green Business Scheme has been launched by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for activities that can tackle the impacts of climate change and also be income-generating.

items.briefDescription: Under the Green House Scheme Farmers can get the benefit of subsidy on green house and earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetables, flowers, fruits etc. by controlling the ago-climatic factors, temperature, humidity and sunlight.

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Griha Lakshmi" aims to provide financial assistance to women heads of households in Karnataka. The scheme offers a monthly benefit of ₹2,000/- to eligible women, helping them manage household expenses and improve their economic stability.

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Group Insurance for Differently Abled Person Government Employees" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. items.schemeName: Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak Yojana

items.briefDescription: A scheme called "Guru Shishya Parampara Scheme" to preserve and promote rare and vanishing art forms on Classical or Folk/Tribal so that the young talents be nurtured to acquire skills in their chosen field of art art under the able guidance of Gurus
items.schemeName: Guru Shishya Parampara

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a financial support initiative by the Jharkhand Government to help students pursue higher education without financial constraints. Under this scheme, eligible students can avail of education loans up to ₹15,00,000 at a subsidized 4% simple interest rate, with additional benefits.
items.schemeName: Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) Scheme

items.schemeName: H.P. Swaran Jayanti Middle Merit Scholarship Scheme

The scheme provides an air fare subsidy of ₹24,000/- for each pilgrim and includes free medical facility while in Mecca. items.schemeName: Halpati Housing Scheme

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Hamaal Hetu Joota, Huk Evan Mahila Hamaal Hetu Soopa Aur Tokari Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.
items.schemeName: Hamaal Hetu Joota, Huk Evan Mahila Hamaal Hetu Soopa Aur Tokari Sahaayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls enrolled under the Palanhar Scheme to pursue higher or technical education, based on their qualifications and interest in employment-oriented courses.
