items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, vocational/technical training is provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys & girls through recognized training providers such as the Rajasthan Skill & Livelihood Development Corporation, Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Ltd., it is etc. recognized by the State or Central Govt.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Professional/Technical Training

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, eligible boys and girls receive financial assistance in two installments - 60% initially and 40% later, to establish self-employment or business ventures. The support is specifically linked to the training course completed by the beneficiary.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Self-Employment/Business

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free training in trades such as sewing, embroidery, knitting, plumbing, electronics, and in Information Technology fields including computer hardware, software, networking, accounting, and more, to individuals belonging to minority communities.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana

items.briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Jan-Van Scheme aims to promote tree plantation on private lands in Jharkhand to enhance farmers' income, conserve the environment, and reduce pressure on notified forests. Farmers are encouraged to plant trees on their lands with incentives covering 75% of plantation and maintenance
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Jan-Van Scheme

items.briefDescription: This scheme has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Through the Mukhyamantri Jankalyan Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, financial assistance will be provided for education to students of Madhya Pradesh.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Jankalyan (Shiksha Protsahan Yojna)

items.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana is a scheme under the Odia Language, Literature & Culture Department, Government of Odisha aims to offer sustenance and assistance to elderly artists who, despite facing financial hardship, have consistently devoted themselves to enriching culture of the state.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: Under the Scheme, Every month financial assistance is provided to the Kalyani (widow) residing in the state for providing social security and subsistence.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kalyakani Pension  Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widowed women during remarriage. It offers a one-time support of ₹2,00,000 to eligible kalyani beneficiaries.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to empower dairy farmers pouring milk at MPCS by providing additional income opportunities, ensuring a balanced milk supply for OMFED during lean seasons. Through this scheme, 1,25,000 milk-pouring members of MPCS under OMFED are expected to benefit.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Cash Incentive Sub-scheme for Dairy Farmers

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the scientific rearing of female calves to increase productivity and strengthen the dairy sector. Through this scheme, calf feed assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for rearing selected female calves.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Female Calf Rearing Sub-scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to produce green fodder in farmers’ land to feed livestock and fetch extra income by selling surplus fodder. Through this scheme, a phased subsidy is provided for the cultivation of perennial fodder over the approved land area for 3 consecutive years.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Fodder Entrepreneurship Programme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide insurance coverage to dairy animals to safeguard farmers against financial loss due to the death of insured animals. Through this scheme, insurance coverage is provided to eligible dairy farmers with premium subsidy support.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kamdhenu Yojana: Go-Sampad Bima Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to parents or couples who have only daughters. The scheme provides a recurring monthly pension amount of ₹500/- (Rupees 500) to the eligible recipient or couple. The applicant must be a resident of the state of Madhya Pradesh.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana

items.briefDescription: The Government of Madhya Pradesh has launched a scheme entitled “Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana” on 01 April 201,  for the welfare of citizens having one daughter.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana (MKSY)" is a welfare initiative by the Government of Bihar to combat female foeticide, improve the sex ratio, and promote birth registration.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana

items.briefDescription: In 2006, Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah Yojana" for females/girls.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah / Nikaah Yojana

items.briefDescription: The purpose of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to poor families at the time of marriage, to encourage girls' education, and prevent child marriage.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme was started by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh in 2006. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the mass marriage of girls, widows, and abandoned women from destitute or poor families in the state.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana- Madhya Pradesh

items.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana launched by Social Justice and empowerment in 2015 by Rajasthan for Family provides financial support to eligible families to help them cover the expenses associated with their daughters' weddings.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the state, enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide additional electricity bill subsidy of up to ₹1,000/- per month (maximum ₹12,000/- per year) through adjustment in electricity bills to eligible rural agricultural electricity consumers of Rajasthan.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojna

items.briefDescription: The scheme was launched on September 6, 2019, to provide relief and support to farmers in case of crop damage due to natural calamities and was implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana

items.briefDescription: This initiative by the State Government aimed at reducing school dropout rates among adolescent girls by providing free sanitary napkins, promoting hygiene, and supporting their overall health.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kishori Swasthya Yojna

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a free Scooty to the meritorious girl students, which will be useful for them to travel to their College.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Konya Atmonirbhor Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create necessary infrastructure by the distribution company for providing permanent pump connections to farmers or groups of farmers.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Krishak Mitra Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana” was launched by Dept. of Agriculture, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh by merging 3 ongoing protection-based Departmental schemes namely Sour Badhbandi, Anti-Hail Net Structure & Green House Renovation into single scheme having a common objective.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage large dairy farmers/entrepreneurs to procure high-yielding cattle from outside the state. Through this scheme, an additional 15% subsidy on animal cost as a Top-Up will be provided to the entrepreneurs towards the purchase of animals from outside the state.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Krushi Udyog Yojana: Top-up subsidy for Commercial Dairy Farming

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a Scheduled Tribe family receives 50kg of wheat or rice and cooking utensils from the Panchayat upon the birth of a child. In the event of a family member's death, the family is provided with 1 quintal of wheat or rice.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Madad Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women by providing nutritional food such as eggs twice a week and dates twice a week at Anganwadi Centres.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana

items.briefDescription: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana

items.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women in the state. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs and to promote their entrepreneurial spirit.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana

items.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Majdur Suraksha Yojana provides registered rural and agriculture-based labourers in Madhya Pradesh with maternity assistance, scholarships for children, insurance cover and wage-loss compensation. Ensures social security for unorganised workers’ families.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Majadoor Suraksha Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar” was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura, to provide financial assistance of ₹500/- to pregnant women through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for antenatal checkups at any health facility.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance maternal and child health by providing nutritional support to first-time pregnant women and mothers of young children during the crucial first 1000 days of life.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance fish production, generate employment opportunities, and improve the livelihoods of fish farmers by providing free training, field visits, and seminars on various fisheries-related activities.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Matsya Sampada Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 6, 7, and 8 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the SCERT, Uttarakhand.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Junior Level)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 9 and 10 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the SCERT, Uttarakhand.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students entering Classes 11 and 12 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students who have secured 80% or more marks in the Uttarakhand Board Examination of Class 10.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level- Class 11 & 12)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure first, second, or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to cover the tuition fees for meritorious students from Madhya Pradesh admitted to graduate courses. Financial assistance for admission and course fees is provided to eligible students through this scheme.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidhyarti Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme empowers tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project cost.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free quality diagnostic facilities at all government health institutions in Gujarat. It benefits rural population by offering essential laboratory tests, X-ray, sonography services without charge at nearby government healthcare centers.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to support farmers in ensuring water availability through borewell construction and motor pump installation.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nijee Nalkup Yojana

items.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the needy girls, widows, and abandoned women from destitute or poor Muslim families in the state at the time of their marriage (In case of mass marriage).
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nikah Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas Evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Suraksha Upakaran Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur suraksha upakaran sahaayata yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 11 January 2012.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata" for Building and other construction worker on 29 March 2023.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata

items.briefDescription: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh started this scheme on March 1, 2023, under the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board." The scheme provides free coaching assistance for children of construction workers.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: The allowance will be provided by the Government of Bihar to the educated unemployed citizens under the Chief Minister Self Help Allowance Scheme. So that the citizens of the state do not have to face financial crisis.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nischay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojna

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to General category students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-General

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Other Backward Class(OBC) students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-OBC

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Specially Backward Class (SBC) students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SBC

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Scheduled Caste students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-SC

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free coaching and residential facilities to Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan for various competitive examinations through reputed coaching institutes.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Coaching Yojana-ST

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support poor families by reducing their household fuel expenses. Under this scheme, Antyodaya (pink card) ration card holders in the state are entitled to receive three free gas cylinder refills every year.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 06 January 2012.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana" for the girl child of the family.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve employability through free skill training for youth of backward and extremely backward communities.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Pragatisheel Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana" is an initiative under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aimed to encourage the trend of rearing indigenous breed of cows with high quality and productivity in the state & motivate cattle farmers for breed improvement of cows, their better care.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: "Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana" to provide transportation facilities connecting blocks & remote Panchayats with district headquarters. This scheme aims to encourage scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, backward classes entrepreneurship by providing financial support to purchase buses.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana" by the Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to unemployed candidates who have completed skill training programs aligned with NSQF.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana Jharkhand

items.briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana is a program launched by the Rajasthan government in June 2016. It aims to improve the overall development of girls in the state by providing financial assistance for their health and education.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana

items.briefDescription: “Mukhyamantri Rajya Bridhhabasta Pension Yojana” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial asistance to the age group of 60 years and above.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Rajya Bridhhabasta Pension Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help sugarcane farmers grow better crops, increase production, improve sugar quality, and provide support through high-quality seeds, modern techniques, mechanization, crop protection, and advanced farming practices.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Rajya Krishi Vikas Yojana

items.briefDescription: “Mukhyamantri Rajya Nirashrit Mahila Samman Pension Yojana” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand, that aims to provide social security to women who are unable to sustain themselves with their own resources.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Rajya Nirashrit Mahila Samman Pension Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Bicycle Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Old and Infirm" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to poor people of Tripura who are old and infirm, such as senior citizens.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Old and Infirm

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura to provide financial assistance to Persons with Disabilities in the form of a monthly pension of ₹2,000/-.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Persons with Disabilities

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa-Unorganized Workers" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial benefits to Unorganized Workers (home-based, self-employed or wage workers).
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Unorganized Workers

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa- Vulnerable Women" was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura to provide financial assistance to Vulnerable Woman in need of special care, support or protection because of age, disability.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Vulnerable Women

items.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes Dept., Govt. of Haryana to promote communal harmony by encouraging inter-caste marriages. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2.5 lakhs to couple when a Non-Scheduled Caste boy or girl marries with a SC girl/boy.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana" under Seven Nishchay-2, aims to develop undeveloped and unutilized private land in Bihar for fish-based integrated aquaculture. With a budget of ₹2972.79 lakh, the scheme targets the sustainable development of 600 hectares of Chaur land, enhancing fish.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance nutritional support for all adolescent girls aged 15 -19 years across the state. However, in the 10 Aspirational Districts, the coverage is limited to girls aged 18 -19 years.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Adolescent Girls Nutrition

items.briefDescription: This initiative aims to make Kishori Diwas more engaging and eventful. Any Saturday in the month of January may be celebrated as “Kishori Mela”, with increased participation and a range of activities for all adolescent girls aged 15 - 19 years.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Kishori Mela

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Maternal Nutrition

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve child nutrition outcomes, with a specific focus on providing nutritional support to Severely Underweight (SUW) and Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) children aged between 3 years and 6 years.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (3 years - 6 years)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve child nutrition outcomes, with a specific focus on providing nutritional support to Severely Underweight (SUW) and Moderately Acute Malnourished (MAM) children aged between 6 months and 3 years.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Nutrition for Severely Underweight and Moderately Acute Malnourished Children (6 months - 3 years)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide nutritional support to Severely Acute Malnourished (SAM) children. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided Take Home Ration (THR) of 3 kg per month, along with 30 eggs per month, for a duration of 112 days.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Purna Aahaara for Children (6 months - 5 years)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, wedding programs are conducted according to the rituals being practiced in various communities and religions. Another objective of the scheme is to abolish the unwanted and extravagance in wedding ceremonies
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency

items.briefDescription: Under the scheme, a cash award of ₹50,000 will be given to students studying in government schools affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer, who secure the highest marks in the EWS category in the Class 10th and Class 12th examinations (Arts, Commerce, and Science streams).
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana for Students of Economically Weaker Section

items.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" by the Directorate of Higher Education, Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide free coaching and financial assistance to students prepare for national level competitive examinations like JEE, NEET, CLAT, NHMC
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana" for construction worker on 12 May 2022.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shramik Siyaan Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to men and women aged 18 to 45 from the minority community by offering vocational skill training in various fields or by providing loans through the Bihar State Minority Financial Corporation, Patna, for self-employment.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana

items.briefDescription: Launched on 9th February 2024 the "Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme-Retired Person" was launched by the Directorate of Youth Affairs & Sports, Govt. of Tripura. The scheme aims to generate employment opportunities for retired persons by giving a monthly fixed remuneration of ₹30,000/-.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Retired Person

items.briefDescription: Launched on 9th February 2024, "Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Unemployed Young Professional Sportsperson" was launched by the Directorate of Youth Affairs & Sports, Govt. of Tripura. The scheme aims to generate employment opportunities for young experienced professional sportspersons
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sports Development Scheme - Unemployed Young Professional Sportsperson

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help the farmers to get financial assistance for the purchase of cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes and cows of indigenous breeds namely Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi and Tharparkar for their Dairy Unit, to promote self employment in the Dairy Sector.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive care, education, and support to orphans, abandoned children, specially-abled individuals, destitute women, and senior citizens, recognizing them as “children of the state” and ensuring their holistic development.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Sukh Ashray Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana" under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aims to enhance milk productivity and per capita milk availability in Uttar Pradesh by encouraging the purchase of indigenous improved breed cows from outside the state and employment opportunities in rural areas.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Svadeshi Gau Samvardhan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing new enterprises or upgrading existing small-scale units.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana - Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Swasthya Sahayata Yojana" by the Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, & Backward Classes Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to provide medical financial aid to beneficiaries. It covers illnesses, surgeries, & nutritional support during & after treatment.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Swasthya Sahayata Yojana Jharkhand

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Religious Trusts and Endowments, Government of Madhya Pradesh in June 2012.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Teerth Darshan Yojana

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, members of families with an annual income of less than ₹1.80 lakhs who are over 60 years of age will be taken for pilgrimages to Ayodhya, Varanasi, and other sacred places. The state government will bear all the expenses for their travel.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana

items.briefDescription: The Delhi government’s Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Scheme, under which people over the age of 60 are taken for a pilgrimage free of cost, is expected to restart in a month’s time. The scheme, which started in 2018, has been suspended for a year and a half because of Covid. Between 2018 and 2020.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana - Delhi

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sports among talented children aged 8 to 14 years in Uttarakhand by providing a monthly scholarship of ₹1,500. Players in this age group are selected every year on the basis of Physical & Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT), with 150 boys & 150 girls selected from each district.
items.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana
