items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nirmaan Shramik  Ke Bachchon Hetu Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana" for Construction worker on 23 May 2017.
items.schemeName: Nirmaan Shramik  ke Bachchon Hetu  Utkrasht Khel Protsaahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.
items.schemeName: Nirmaan Shramik Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families of unregistered workers who die during construction work in Madhya Pradesh.
items.schemeName: Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti  Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage registered construction workers and their children to participate in international sports competitions by providing financial incentives for participation and winning medals.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Antarashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyon Hetu Protsahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The purpose of the Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana is to encourage people employed in Labour Department building, other construction works to participate in international sports by providing them incentives for participating and excelling in international sports.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK AUZAAR TOOLKIT SAHAYATA YOJANA is a social welfare scheme launched by the Government of Jharkhand to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers in the state for the purchase of essential tools and equipment required for their work.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Auzaar Toolkit Sahayata Yojana

items.briefDescription: The Labor department of Rajasthan started "Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana" to help the children of construction workers.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Nirman Shramik Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Labour and Employee's State Insurance Department, Government of Odisha. The objective of the scheme is to extend financial assistance to eligible building and other construction workers for continuing education of their wards/children.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Kalyan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The “Nirman Shramik Pension Yojana (NSPY)” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a social welfare scheme that provides pension to the eligible registered beneficiary or their dependents in certain circumstances.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Pension Yojana (NSPY) (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: Labour and ESI Department, Government of Odisha has introduced a scheme "Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana (NSPGY)" to meet the housing needs of the building and other construction workers in rural areas, registered under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (OB&OCWWB).
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Pucca Ghar Yojana

items.briefDescription: "Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides a direct cash transfer of ₹ 1,000/- for purchasing a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Safety Kit Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide educational assistance and skill development support to registered construction workers and their dependent children to promote education, technical training, and employability.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Shiksha evam Kaushal Vikas Yojana

items.briefDescription: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK SIKSHA KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA (NSKKVY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance for education and skill development to the children of registered construction workers in the state.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Siksha Kaushal Vikas Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide housing grant assistance to registered construction workers under approved Central or State Government housing schemes or for construction of a house on their own plot.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Sulabhn Awas Yojana

items.briefDescription: The Labor department of Rajasthan started "Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana" to help construction workers.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana

items.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana" for construction worker on 09 December 2022.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide reimbursement of tuition fees to the sons and daughters of registered construction workers who secure admission in IITs or IIMs, ensuring access to quality higher education.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramikon Ke Putra Putri Ka IIT IIM Mein Pravesh Milne Par Tuition Fees Ki Purnbharan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Nirman Shramik Rin Punarbharan Yojana" helps construction workers by reimbursing interest on their business loans. This program aims to ease the financial burden of construction workers by reducing their loan interest payments.
items.schemeName: Nirman Shramikon ke Liye Vyavsayik Rin Par Byaj ki Punarbharan Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote higher education among children of fisher families working in federation reservoirs by providing scholarships of up to ₹20,000 for technical courses and up to ₹10,000 for non-technical courses.
items.schemeName: Nishadraj Scholarship Scheme

items.briefDescription: "Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides a pension of ₹ 1,000/- per month to the registered beneficiary who is permanently disabled due to paralysis/leprosy/tuberculosis/accident.
items.schemeName: Nishaktata Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free uniforms to all girl students studying in Classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, as well as to all boys belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and boys from the General category who fall under the BPL category.
items.schemeName: Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure accessible, affordable and quality healthcare services for all citizens of Uttarakhand by providing free diagnostic tests across government healthcare facilities.
items.schemeName: Nishulk Swasthya Jaanch Yojana - Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability who are below the age of 18 years. The child should be enrolled in a special school run by a Non-Governmental Aided Organization. Vocational Training is given to special children above the age of 18 years.
items.schemeName: Non-Governmental Aided Organization (Special Schools And Vocational Training Centre) For Disabled

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the educational and health status of girls, lay the foundation for their bright future, prevent female feticide, promote a positive attitude towards the birth of girls, and prevent child marriage.  It provides financial benefit to girls who remain unmarried until 18 years.
items.schemeName: Noni Suraksha Yojana

items.briefDescription: North East Skill Centre (NESC) -> Assam Skill Development Mission (ASDM) | Skill Employment & Entrepreneurship Department (SEED) under Government of Assam
items.schemeName: North East Skill Centre

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of BPO and Information Technology Enabled Services units in the North-Eastern region. Through the scheme, financial assistance in the form of Viability Gap Funding is provided to eligible companies.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
items.schemeName: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "Nursing Skill College" scheme provides skill-based nursing education and employment opportunities to young women, especially from disadvantaged backgrounds. The scheme offers free residential training, modern learning facilities, and placement support.
items.schemeName: Nursing Kaushal College Jharkhand

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to facilitate the expeditious disposal of ten to fifteen years old pending court cases. It provides legal advice, case assistance, and Lok Adalat referrals to marginalized litigants by engaging retired officers.
items.schemeName: Nyaya Mitra Scheme

items.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship for Other Backward Class (OBC) students. This scholarship aims to financially assist students from these categories to pursue secondary education and complete their matriculation.
items.schemeName: OBC Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh

items.briefDescription: The Scheme “OEC Pre-matric Educational Assistance” was started by the Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala to provide educational assistance to pre-matric students belonging to these communities who are studying in Government/Aided/Unaided schools from Classes 1st to 10th.
items.schemeName: OEC Pre-matric Educational Assistance

items.briefDescription: “Observation Home and Special School" was launched by the Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry. The scheme aims to take care of the children who are juvenile delinquents by providing a home to them where their basic needs are taken care of including general and vocational education.
items.schemeName: Observation Home and Special School

items.briefDescription: The Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (SSEPD) Department, Government of Odisha, recognises that beggars are valuable human resources for society and seeks to create an environment that provides them equal opportunities.
items.schemeName: Odisha Sahaya Scheme - Pre & Post Matric Scholarship

items.briefDescription: The Odisha State Treatment Fund will provide financial assistance for treatment of the poor patients suffering from life threatening disorders & diseases. The financial assistance will be released to the Medical Institutions where the patient undergoes treatment.
items.schemeName: Odisha State Treatment Fund

items.briefDescription: The Government of Puducherry introduced Old Age And Destitute Pension Scheme to extend a helping hand by way of monthly financial assistance to Old Age Persons/Widows/ Deserted Women/ Unmarried Women and Enuches so that they could defray some petty personal expenses without depending on others.
items.schemeName: Old Age And Destitute Pension

items.briefDescription: Old Age Assistance or Pension is a welfare scheme of Delhi Govt to provide assistance to Old age needy persons. The primary goal of this scheme is to offer eligible senior citizens financial help in the form of monthly pensions.
items.schemeName: Old Age Assistance

items.briefDescription: This scheme is to bring qualitative improvement in the living standards of old people of the state. Establishment and expansion of rehabilitation programs/ services and capacity building for strengthening the delivery of rehabilitation programs and services.
items.schemeName: Old Age Home (Sahara)

items.briefDescription: The "Old Age Homes" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme is to bring qualitative improvement in the living standards of old people of the state.
items.schemeName: Old Age Homes - Tamil Nadu

items.briefDescription: In 2010, the Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department of the West Bengal State Government introduced the "Old Age Pension" scheme.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension

items.briefDescription: The Old Age Pension scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to elderly citizens who have reached a certain age and require regular income for their sustenance.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension - Chandigarh

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Old Age Pension Scheme” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme (APB&OCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The "Old Age Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides pension to registered construction workers aged above 60 years and have completed 3 years of membership with the Board.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 60 years.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme - On Completion of 60 Years (UKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Punjab State Government started a pension for old age person of the state people.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme - Punjab

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to senior citizens (both husband and wife) in the state who are 60 years of age or above and whose family’s monthly income is up to ₹4,000/- or who belong to the BPL category.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: The 'Old Age Pension Scheme under Chief Minister’s Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam' is a state scheme. The scheme aims to give a pension of ₹1,000/- to old-age farmers and destitute agricultural labourers who have membership card under CMPUT.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme under Chief  Minister’s Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 65 years.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme- On Completion Of 65 Years (UKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The “Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers” scheme implemented by the MSME and Textiles Dept., aims to provide monthly financial assistance in the form of pension to a weaver member of a handloom cooperative society.
items.schemeName: Old Age Pension To Handloom Weavers Under Coop. Fold

items.briefDescription: "Old Age Samman Allowance" is a social security scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. The scheme provides a pension of ₹ 3000/month to senior citizens (60 years of age or older) who are unable to sustain themselves with their own resource
items.schemeName: Old Age Samman Allowance

items.briefDescription: The Himachal Pradesh government offers an Old Age pension scheme to support elderly citizens who have no means of livelihood. The scheme offers financial assistance to eligible citizens based on their age and income level.
items.schemeName: Old-Age Pension Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "One Act Play Competition" is a Cultural Scheme by the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, encouraging students' personality development through theatre, with participation open to all Goan schools and colleges, and transport assistance provided as per government norms.
items.schemeName: One Act Play competition at High School, Higher Secondary School and College level (Konkani, Marathi & English)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and celebrate the outstanding efforts of States, UTs, Districts, and Indian Missions Abroad in promoting local products. It also seeks to boost economic development and support the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat.
items.schemeName: One District One Product (ODOP) Awards

items.briefDescription: The Government of Kerala approved the scheme “One Family One Enterprise” to encourage entrepreneurial activity in every household and empower women's entrepreneurship. This scheme aims to set up at least one MSME unit including trade activity in each family.
items.schemeName: One Family One Enterprise Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Employment, Government of Haryana on 1st December, 1992 in Haryana State. Eligible applicants can register their names under this scheme, making them eligible for all benefits provided by the Employment Department.
items.schemeName: One Family One Job Scheme

items.briefDescription: "One Nation, One Ration Card" is Aadhaar-based national ration card portability scheme to ensure food security for all, including internal migrants within India, under which beneficiaries can purchase subsidized food anywhere in India.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Consumer Affairs, Food And Public Distribution
items.schemeName: One Nation One Ration Card

items.briefDescription: The objective of the One Tea Scheme is to ensure a minimum guaranteed price for fresh tea leaves to protect tea farmers from financial losses and provide economic stability. It also aims to support bought-leaf factories and promote sustainable tea cultivation in Meghalaya.
items.schemeName: One Tea Scheme

items.briefDescription: “One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)”  by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to aid the farmers in procuring manually operated small farm implements necessary for agricultural operations.
items.schemeName: One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)

items.briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training" by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry, provides upto ₹10,000/- to the unemployed Ex-servicemen / Widow/Dependent of the ESM to pursue the mentioned programs/courses.
items.schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training (Sainik Welfare)

items.briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards Learning Driving" is a Welfare Scheme by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, up to ₹4,000/- is provided to the unemployed Ex-servicemen to learn to drive. The driving course should be taken from a Government-recognized School/Institution.
items.schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards Learning Driving (Sainik Welfare)

items.briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, up to ₹20,000/- is provided to the unemployed Ex-servicemen to pursue the mentioned programs/courses.
items.schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA (Sainik Welfare)

items.briefDescription: The "One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students" scheme aims to provide financial assistance ₹1,00,000/- to the economically weaker meritorious schedule tribe students to pursue different professional & other courses in government-recognized institutes/colleges.
items.schemeName: One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students

items.briefDescription: "One Time Grant for Media Personality" is a Financial Assistance Scheme by the Information and Public Relations Department, Govt. of Assam. Through this scheme, the govt. provides a one-time grant to twenty journalists ₹ 50,000/- each every year.
items.schemeName: One Time Grant For Media Personality

items.briefDescription: "One Time Settlement (O.T.S.) Scheme" aims to recover outstanding electricity dues from defaulting consumers by offering a waiver of delayed payment charges. Beneficiaries can pay only the principal amount in a lump sum, applicable to consumers with arrears up to ₹20,000/- as of 31-3-2008.
items.schemeName: One Time Settlement (O.T.S.) Scheme

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state who have been conferred with the ‘Vishisht Seva Medal Award’.
items.schemeName: One-Time Grant Money to Soldiers Conferred with Vishisht Seva Medal Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a common platform for officers, teachers, and students from universities, colleges, schools, and other departments to actively participate and gain knowledge about the simplified curriculum of Vedic Mathematics and its easy-to-apply methods.
items.schemeName: One-day Seminar on Vedic Mathematics

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/annuity is provided to serving or ex-servicemen who have been conferred with the “Gallantry Medal Award.” In the event of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the grant is extended to the eligible family members or dependents.
items.schemeName: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals

items.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra has introduced a scheme "Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes" to voluntary organizations to run the Public School (Vidya Niketan) on a grant-in-aid basis.
items.schemeName: Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes

items.briefDescription: The Govt. of Maharashtra vide G.R. dated 26/6/2008 launched the scheme “Opening and Running Junior Colleges for VJNT Students Run by Voluntary Agencies” for the educational and social development of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students.
items.schemeName: Opening And Running Junior Colleges For VJNT Students Run By Voluntary Agencies

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Government of Puducherry, provides boarding/lodging and hostel facilities to Scheduled Caste students in pursuance of their education and to dissuade dropping of education at school and college level.
items.schemeName: Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide artificial insemination services for cattle and buffaloes to improve livestock productivity and benefit livestock owners across various villages.
items.schemeName: Operating Artificial Insemination Centers

items.briefDescription: The scheme provide accommodation and basic facilities to tribal students who cannot pursue education in distant schools due to the absence of nearby institutions and poor financial conditions.
items.schemeName: Operating Ashram Hostel

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free quality residential education, boarding, uniforms, and essential facilities to Scheduled Tribe students residing in tribal areas who lack access to nearby higher-level schools.
items.schemeName: Operating Eklavya Model Residential School

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free quality residential education, boarding, uniforms, and essential facilities to Scheduled Tribe students residing in tribal areas who lack access to nearby higher-level schools.
items.schemeName: Operating Residential School

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national and international competitions by providing free hostel accommodation, food, training, and study support.
items.schemeName: Operating Sports Hostel

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free accommodation, nutritious meals, educational materials, uniforms, personal hygiene items, and other facilities are provided to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students residing in ashram hostels operated by the Tribal Area Development Department.
items.schemeName: Operation of Ashram Hostels

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote safe, regulated, and professional paragliding activities in Uttarakhand by permitting certified paragliding companies and licensed tandem pilots to operate within the state.
items.schemeName: Operation of Paragliding Activities

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote safe & regulated adventure tourism in the state by allowing licensed rafting companies to operate & issuing certifications to qualified river guides. Under this scheme, rafting companies are granted permission to operate, and licenses are issued to qualified river guides.
items.schemeName: Operation of River Rafting / Kayaking Activities

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Operation of SC Senior Hostel" provides accommodations and a conducive learning environment for Scheduled Caste students. Through this scheme, separate junior, senior, and college hostels with free boarding and lodging facilities are provided to both boys and girls.
items.schemeName: Operation of SC Senior Hostel

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national & international competitions. Tribal students from Classes 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodation, specialized training, nutritious meals & other necessary facilities in the sports hostels.
items.schemeName: Operation of Sports Hostels

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to preserve the oral history of tiatr for future generations through documentation of veteran artistes' experiences. It provides video recording and remuneration to eligible veteran tiatr artistes.
items.schemeName: Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide hands on training at the village level on production of organic compost inputs such as compost for plant health management for sustainable agriculture.
items.schemeName: Organic Manure Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists registered with the Department for performing in cultural programs organized during traditional fairs, festivals, regional celebrations within and outside the state, as well as on the occasion of national festivals.
items.schemeName: Organisation of Cultural Programs

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sports at the grassroots levels by providing structured training, organizing competitions & nurturing sporting talent. Training is conducted through local camps in all districts for various sports, including football, athletics, boxing, volleyball, etc. with minimal fees.
items.schemeName: Organising Sports Competitions and Training Camps

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to organize camps & awareness programs across urban & rural areas to inform and empower vulnerable groups such as women, children, senior citizens, workers in the unorganized sector, persons with disabilities, acid attack survivors & victims of trafficking about their legal rights.
items.schemeName: Organization of Multi-Purpose Camps/ Public Awareness Camps/ Medical Camps/Legal Service Camps

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sports & identify grassroots-level talent among youth through structured competitions & training. Players are provided with cash prizes and free training, & participation is encouraged at multiple levels, including Gram Panchayat, Development Block, District, and State.
items.schemeName: Organization of Sports Competitions and Training Programs

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development of women, women scientists, teachers, and young students of the state by organizing conclaves and felicitating them.
items.schemeName: Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students

items.briefDescription: The “Organizing Block Demonstration” scheme provides a 50% subsidy or ₹2,000/- (whichever is less) on input costs for demonstrating the cultivation of Pulses crops over 5 hectares.
items.schemeName: Organizing Block Demonstration

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU" offers grants to farmers for maize cultivation. Farmers can avail a subsidy for demonstrating cultivation practices on a 1-hectare plot.
items.schemeName: Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers for adopting polythene mulch technology in groundnut cultivation to improve productivity.
items.schemeName: Organizing Block Demonstration on Polythene Mulch Technology in Groundnut

items.briefDescription: The "Orientation Courses in Dramatics" scheme by the Tiatr Academy of Goa aims to improve the quality of tiatr performances. It offers preliminary training and workshops in various aspects of dramatics, such as script writing and acting, to individuals and existing tiatr artistes.
items.schemeName: Orientation Courses in Dramatics

items.briefDescription: Orunodoi, described as 'foremost bead' among the Ashtadash Mukutar Unnoyonee Maala was announced by then HFM in his Budget Speech 20-21. It envisages women empowerment, poverty alleviation and socio-economic inclusion of financially vulnerable women of the state through sustained financial assistanc
items.schemeName: Orunodoi 3.0

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Other Backward Class (OBC) students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.
items.schemeName: Other Backward Caste Dashamottar Scholarship Scheme (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: The "Out of School Children" scheme is designed to ensure that every child in the 6-14 age group receives a complete elementary education. The primary objective is to identify children who are out of school and to reintegrate them into the educational system through specialized training programs.
items.schemeName: Out of School Children scheme under Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhivan

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide job opportunities to medal-winning sportspersons of Uttarakhand, who have represented the state in international and national games, by offering them out-of-turn employment in various state services.
items.schemeName: Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services

items.briefDescription: The "Overseas Educational Loan Scheme" objective is to provide financial/loan assistance to students belonging to minority communities who are pursuing graduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized universities abroad.
items.schemeName: Overseas Educational Loan Scheme

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to build national capacity in frontier areas of Science and Engineering, which are of interest to India by providing research training to PhD students admitted in the Indian institutions in overseas universities / institutions of repute.
items.schemeName: Overseas Visiting Doctoral Fellowship

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide permanent irrigation pump connections to farmers quickly by allowing them to install their own transformers.
items.schemeName: Own Transformer Scheme

items.briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to train and develop skilled youth of Uttarakhand, aged between 18 to 30 years, who are educated, mentally, and physically fit, to become professional paragliding pilots and instructors.
items.schemeName: P1, P2, P3, P4, SIV, Guided Flying

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the socio-economic status of PVTGs by saturating families and habitations with basic facilities and services. It provides 11 critical infrastructure and welfare interventions, including housing, water, electricity, and connectivity.
items.schemeName: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)

items.briefDescription: PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education. Under this scheme, one hot cooked meal will be provided to the children studying in Government and Government – aided schools. The Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education.
items.schemeName: PM POSHAN - Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme For Holistic Nourishment

items.briefDescription: The schemes aims to develop 5 NSTIs as premier National Centres of Excellence for Skilling. Through this scheme, infrastructure upgradation, new trades, and trainer development are provided to the 5 NSTIs and their stakeholders.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
items.schemeName: PM SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) – Component II: Capacity Augmentation of Five National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs) and Setting up of Five National Centres of Excellence for Skilling

items.briefDescription: PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme launched on 1st June 2020 by the MoHUA to provide handholding support to street vendors. The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy.
items.schemeName: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

items.briefDescription: The scheme "PM Vishwakarma " by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, is a new scheme that envisages providing end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople in scaling up their conventional products and services.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
items.schemeName: PM Vishwakarma

items.briefDescription: "PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana" is a government scheme that aims to provide free electricity to households in India.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
items.schemeName: PM – Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to train and create a professional cadre of geriatric caregivers to meet the increasing demand for specialized care for senior citizens. It offers skill development and certification in geriatric care job roles to Indian citizens, ensuring professional services for the elderly.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the OBC, EBC and DNT students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students

items.briefDescription: The objective of the Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students (who are not covered under SC, ST, or OBC) is welfare and motivation to the children of these categories by providing financial assistance at pre-matriculation or secondary stage.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to recognize and promote quality education amongst Students belonging to OBC, EBC and DNT categories by providing full financial support. The Scheme will cover OBC/EBC/DNT students for pursuing studies beyond Class XII.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students

items.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide premium education to the meritorious students belonging to OBC, EBC, and DNT categories by funding their education from Class 9 onwards till they complete Class 12.
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
items.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Top Class School Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for the modernisation of Cold storage /Ice Plant.
items.schemeName: PMMSY : Modernization of Cold storage /Ice Plant - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide sanitation facilities on mechanised fishing vessels. It provides financial assistance depending on category, with once-in-a-lifetime eligibility.
items.schemeName: PMMSY:  Establishment of Bio-toilets in mechanised fishing vessels - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support for the construction of 20-tonne capacity ice plant/storage units, ensuring hygienic fish storage and improving the income of beneficiaries.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of  Plant/Storage of Minimum 20 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for constructing 30-tonne capacity plants or storage units.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of  Plant/Storage of Minimum 30 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the construction of fish kiosks, including those for aquarium/ornamental fish.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Kiosks Including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental Fish-Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the construction of fish retail markets, including those for ornamental fish and aquariums. Through this scheme, financial assistance for project costs is provided to individual beneficiaries.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the construction of ice plants/storage units of at least 10 tonne capacity, supporting fishermen and sellers to maintain fish in fresh and hygienic condition.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of Ice Plant/Storage of Minimum 10 Tonne Capacity - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas through the construction of new grow-out ponds. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for the construction of new grow-out ponds to beneficiaries who are engaged in fisheries.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of New Grow Out Ponds - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, financial assistance and subsidies are provided for the construction of new rearing ponds.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of New Rearing ponds - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of cycles with ice boxes for fisheries activities. Through this scheme, central assistance is provided for newly purchased cycles with ice boxes for the initial crop.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Cycle with Ice Boxes-Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries-Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the installation of open sea cages of 100–120 cubic meter capacity for fish farming in marine waters. This helps fishermen and entrepreneurs to undertake cage-based aquaculture, thereby increasing fish production, ensuring sustainable marine resource utilization.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of open Sea cages (100-120)m3 vol. - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up small-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to general , schedule caste and women beneficiaries .
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The subsidy for 10-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana

items.briefDescription: The subsidy for Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies to expand fisheries production in Haryana.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for freshwater aquaculture in newly constructed ponds to expand fisheries production in Haryana.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for Insulated vehicles.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Insulated vehicles - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support fishers by providing financial assistance for live fish vending centers. A subsidy per unit is provided under PMMSY.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of motorcycles with ice boxes. Through this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive subsidies to enhance their livelihood opportunities.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for new ponds in saline/alkaline areas. Through this scheme, polythene lining costs are provided to beneficiaries constructing new water bodies for fish/shrimp culture.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of vehicles. Through this scheme, subsidy benefits are provided to general, women, and SC/ST category beneficiaries.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Refrigerated vehicles - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for the support for acquisition of deep-sea fishing vessels for traditional fishermen.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Support for Acquisition of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels for Traditional Fishermen - Gujarat
tags: Support For Acquisition Of Deep Sea Fishing Vessels

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen fish storage infrastructure for hygienic preservation. Through this scheme, beneficiaries receive financial assistance for a three-wheeler with an Ice Box, including e-rickshaws for fish vending.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Three wheeler with Ice Box including e-rickshaws for fish vending - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost fish production, exports, and the safety of fishermen. Assistance is given for modernisation, insulated vehicles, and upgradation of fishing vessels to improve income and fish quality.
items.schemeName: PMMSY: Upgradation of existing fishing vessels for export Competency - Gujarat

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support individual innovators which will enable them to achieve the agenda of inclusive development - one of the thrust areas of the XIIth five-year plan (2012-2017). The proposals shall preferably be considered in the following focus sectors: Green technology, Clean energy, etc.
items.schemeName: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote innovations in individuals, start-ups, and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (PRISM). It offers financial support (up to ₹20,00,000/-) for Indian Citizens working on innovation projects requiring fabrication of working models, patenting, or technology transfer.
items.schemeName: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

items.briefDescription: The Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), a prestigious institution under the Department of Space, Government of India, launched the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) Program.
items.schemeName: PRL Junior Research Fellowships

items.briefDescription: The Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS) program is an initiative by the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) to honor the legacy of Prof. Vikram Sarabhai by supporting young doctorates to pursue groundbreaking research in fundamental science with societal impact.
items.schemeName: PRL's Vikram Sarabhai Postdoctoral Fellowship (VISHWAS)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce malnutrition, anemia, and early marriage among adolescent girls in Gujarat by educating them on health, nutrition, life skills, and legal rights, while promoting self-empowerment through various activities.
items.schemeName: PURNA Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to ensure food security for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs). It provides subsidized food grains to enhance their living conditions.
items.schemeName: PVTGs Dakia Yojana (Chief Minister's Food Security Scheme)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide day care facilities for children aged 6 months to 6 years of working couples at a nominal monthly fee in Crèches.
items.schemeName: Paalna Ghar (Crèche)

items.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to support sugar co-operatives by providing financial assistance for modernization, diversification, organic fertilizer production to enhance sugarcane farming and the sugar industry.
items.schemeName: Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure access to supplementary nutrition by all children, residing in hard-to-reach villages where there is no Anganwadi centers. This programme is functioning as an extension of respective Anganwadi Centers in the hard-to-reach villages.
items.schemeName: Pada Pushti Karyakram

items.briefDescription: The "Paddy Procurement Scheme" 2012-13" by the Food, Public Distribution, and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Jharkhand, ensures that farmers receive minimum support price for paddy procurement, preventing distress sales and supporting food security.
items.schemeName: Paddy Procurement Scheme Jharkhand

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote mechanized paddy transplantation under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. It provides ₹3,000 per acre for land preparation, including ploughing and weeding, up to 2 hectares.
items.schemeName: Paddy Transplantor Machine se Dhan Ropayee par Anudan

items.briefDescription: Padho Pardesh is a scheme of interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies for the students belonging to the minority communities. The scheme was launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs in 2006 under the Prime Minister's New 15 Point Programme for the Welfare of Minorities.
items.schemeName: Padho Pardesh

items.briefDescription: The "Paduke Kuteera Scheme" provides roadside cobblers engaged in repair work or footwear production with a steel-made kiosk (Paduke Kuteera) and a tool kit free of cost. The unit cost of each Kuteera is ₹1,25,000, and the scheme includes a signage board display arrangement.
items.schemeName: Padhuke Kuteera Scheme Karnataka

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Rajasthan State Transport Corporation buses to eligible Rajasthan residents who are Padma Award recipients and gallantry medal awardees, as a mark of honor and recognition for their distinguished service.
items.schemeName: Padma Awardee Free Travel Facility

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize distinguished and exceptional achievements across various fields of public service and national importance.
items.schemeName: Padma Awards

items.briefDescription: PECFAR is a fellowship to facilitate a two-way exchange of young early-career Indian and German researchers through short visits for networking and exploring avenues for collaboration and innovation in applied research.
items.schemeName: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research

items.briefDescription: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides a monthly assistance of ₹3000 to foster parents raising orphaned children or children whose mother has remarried after the father's death.
items.schemeName: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and financial assistance to children aged 0 to 18 years requiring special care and supervision in Rajasthan. It ensures their upbringing, education, and overall development through recognized guardians called “Palanhaar”.
items.schemeName: Palanhaar Yojana

items.briefDescription: Palanhar Yojana has been started by the state government of Rajasthan to benefit the orphan and needy children of the state.
items.schemeName: Palanhar Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram Pradhans, Kshetra Panchayat Pramukhs, Zila Panchayat Presidents, and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the people, in the event of their death while in office.
items.schemeName: Panchayat Kalyan Kosh

items.briefDescription: The "Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana" was initiated to provide shelter for stray male cattle by constructing infrastructure in Panchayat Samitis.
items.schemeName: Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide shelter for stray and male cattle by supporting the construction of permanent infrastructure for Nandishalas through financial assistance from the Government of Rajasthan.
items.schemeName: Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme" by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000 per month to each Gram Panchayat for operational and maintenance purposes, ensuring efficient governance at the grassroots level.
items.schemeName: Panchayat Secretariat Strengthening Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock owners.
items.schemeName: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana

items.briefDescription: The project aims to promote sustainable rural development through the application of science & technology to enhance livelihoods in selected villages throughout Uttarakhand. Under the project, rural development initiatives are implemented through the formation of village clusters across the state.
items.schemeName: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Vigyaan Gram Sankul Pariyojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among schools & students by providing cash awards to the best-performing schools at the high school & intermediate levels at the state level, as well as to students securing top positions in Uttarakhand Board High School & Intermediate Examinations.
items.schemeName: Pandit Deendayal Educational Excellence Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide national recognition, financial incentives, and professional encouragement to Indian citizens and institutions contributing significantly to telecom development and its application in sectors such as agriculture, health, education, and commerce.
items.schemeName: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) by offering financial aid up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction. This scheme also ensures that Economically Weaker Sections receive support in securing shelter.
items.schemeName: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (EBC)

items.briefDescription: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to the people belonging to Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes.
items.schemeName: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)

items.briefDescription: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to socially and educationally backward classes, economically backward classes, and nomadic exempted castes for constructing houses across Gujarat.
items.schemeName: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to honor outstanding research in sciences and social sciences by providing ₹1,00,000 and a citation to eminent Indian contributors to promote excellence.
items.schemeName: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Awards for Sciences/Engineering & Technological Sciences/Social Sciences

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to honor and encourage contributions in classical music through national-level awards and recognition to eminent male classical music artists.
items.schemeName: Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to honour the memory of Pandit Omkarnath and promote classical music among young artists by organizing competitive platforms for singing, vocal, and percussion performances. Classical music artists in two age categories can participate.
items.schemeName: Pandit Omkarnath Music Competition

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide insurance benefits in cases of natural death, accidental death, and disability to BPL and Aastha Card holders.
items.schemeName: Pannadhay Jeevan Amrit Yojana (Janshree Insurance Scheme)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarship benefits to the children of insured members. It supports eligible students studying in class 9th, 10th, 11th and 12th through monthly, quarterly and annual scholarship assistance.
items.schemeName: Pannadhay Jeevan Amrit Yojana (Janshree Insurance Scheme) – Scholarship

items.briefDescription: The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY), launched in 2015, is an extended component of Soil Health Management (SHM) under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS), National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA).
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
items.schemeName: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote & support organic farming among farmers in Uttarakhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹9,000/- per hectare to farmers for the purchase of organic inputs, including seeds, compost, green manure, biofertilizers, biopesticides, neem oil, etc.
items.schemeName: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: "Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides 50% of the pension amount or a maximum of ₹ 500/- to the family members of the deceased pensioner.
items.schemeName: Parivaar Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for vehicle purchases in the transport sector for SEBC unemployed individuals. A loan is provided under the scheme.
items.schemeName: Parivahan Scheme (GBCDC)

items.briefDescription: The "Partial Disability Benefit for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides financial assistance is provided to the nominees/ dependents of a member, in case of his/her partial disability.
items.schemeName: Partial Disability Benefit for the Construction Workers

items.briefDescription: The Himachal Pradesh Council for Science, Technology & Environment (HIMCOSTE), has a scheme for providing partial travel assistance to deserving bright young Scientists and Research Scholars working in state
items.schemeName: Partial Travel Support Scheme

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- is provided to orphans and destitute children, children suffering from HIV/AIDS/Visible Deformities (Grade II), or children of parents suffering from these conditions, who are between the ages of 0 and 18 years.
items.schemeName: Parwarish Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme 'Pashu Bima Yojna' was launched by the Directorate of Dairy Development, Government of Bihar. The scheme aims to provide insurance security to farmers against the financial loss caused by cattle death and to improve the rural economy.
items.schemeName: Pashu Bima Yojana

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000 are provided to sanitation workers and their dependents at an interest rate of 6% for self-employment in animal husbandry or related activities.
items.schemeName: Pashu Palan Yojana (GSKVN)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the livelihoods of Thakor and Koli communities by providing financial assistance for animal husbandry activities such as dairy farming. Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹1,00,000/- are provided for the purchase of milch animals such as cows and buffaloes.
items.schemeName: Pashu Palan Yojana (GTKVN)

items.briefDescription: Launched on 20th June 2013, the scheme "Pashudhan Mitra Scheme1" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Govt of Chhattisgarh, aims to expand veterinary and breeding services, strengthen service delivery, and provide incentive honorariums to Pashudhan Mitras for livelihood support.
items.schemeName: Pashudhan Mitra Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide an amount for animal husbandry activities. Low-interest loans are provided to Pashu Palaks.
items.schemeName: Pashupalan (GBCDC)

items.briefDescription: "Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides loan assistance for animal husbandry to Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backward classes.
items.schemeName: Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana

items.briefDescription: The "Passenger Auto Rickshaw Loan Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department offers financial assistance in the form of loans to Scheduled Caste individuals from Antyodaya families to purchase passenger auto rickshaws and enhance their livelihood opportunities.
items.schemeName: Passenger Auto Rickshaw Loan Scheme (DAADC)

items.briefDescription: The "Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial support to unemployed individuals from Antyodaya Caste for purchasing passenger or freight vehicles.
items.schemeName: Passenger Vehicle/Loading Vehicle Loan Scheme (DAADC)

items.briefDescription: The objective of the "Patent Filing Reimbursement Scheme" is to provide Patent Filing Reimbursement to the eligible Information Technology Units in the State of Goa. A total reimbursement of up to ₹ 25,00,000 per unit for the expenses incurred towards the filing of patents during the policy period.
items.schemeName: Patent Filing Reimbursement Scheme

items.briefDescription: The "Paternity Benefit" scheme by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides ₹6,000/- per delivery to the wife of a registered worker (for up to two deliveries) and ₹1,000/- to the male worker upon the birth of a child.
items.schemeName: Paternity Benefit (HPBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The "Paternity Benefit Scheme" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides ₹6,000/- per childbirth to the male workers, provided that their wife is not registered with the Board.
items.schemeName: Paternity Benefit Scheme (BBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Paternity Benefit Scheme (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.
items.schemeName: Paternity Benefit Scheme (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the meritorious Higher Secondary School Students of Odisha having proficiency in Mathematics.
items.schemeName: Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent (Class - 11 To 12)

items.briefDescription: The "Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana" aims to promote fisheries by constructing ponds and setting up related supporting units in plateau-dominated districts. The initiative is designed to create new employment opportunities and provide a means of livelihood for farmers.
items.schemeName: Pathari Kshetr Talab Nirman Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for emergencies like medical treatment, marriage, and education. Benefits include aid up to ₹2,00,000/and scholarships for dependents. Eligible journalists must be registered and working in Goa for at least three years.
items.schemeName: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)

items.briefDescription: The “Pay & Play Scheme” aims to provide state-level players with training and practice opportunities at the Mega Sports Complex, Hotwar, Ranchi.
items.schemeName: Pay & Play Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure timely online payment to farmers for wheat sold at government procurement centers through the Just-In-Time (JIT) system directly into their bank accounts.
items.schemeName: Payment Related to Wheat Procurement

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, farmers are enabled to sell teak and sal wood to the government at notified rates, ensuring fair compensation through timely e-payment.
items.schemeName: Payment in the Owner-Occupied / Public Forestry Case

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Payment of Death Benefit" under the Labour and Employment Department, Himachal Pradesh, provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of registered members. In case of accidental death, ₹4,00,000 is given, while ₹2,00,000 is payable in case of natural death.
items.schemeName: Payment of Death Benefit ( HPBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the legal dependents of deceased UPNL employees in the event of the employee’s death during their service period.
items.schemeName: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service

items.briefDescription: Launched on 1st June 2004, the scheme "Payment of Ex-Gratia to the Families of Suicidal Weavers" by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Govt. of Andhra Pradesh, provides ex-gratia of ₹ 1,50,000/- provided to the family / next of kin of the weavers who commit suicide due to weaving-related distress.
items.schemeName: Payment of Ex-Gratia to the Families of Suicidal Weavers

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Payroll Subsidy" by the Govt of Tamil Nadu, is introduced with the objective of assisting MSMEs in reducing their employee cost.
