items.briefDescription: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, that provides one-time assistance to the registered Migrant Worker in case of disability arising out of accidents during work.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Accidental Disability

items.briefDescription: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Government of West Bengal, that provides an one time assistance to the nominee of the worker for cremation when the worker dies.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation

items.briefDescription: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance" is a social welfare scheme by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Government of West Bengal, that provides an one time assistance to the nominee in case of natural death/accidental death of the migrant worker.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Death Assistance

items.briefDescription: "West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Board, that provides an one time assistance to the nominee for bringing the dead body of the registered migrant worker in case of death.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body

items.briefDescription: The Higher Education Department, Government of West Bengal has introduced the Student Credit Card Scheme for the students of West Bengal to enable them to pursue higher education without having any financial constraints.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme

items.briefDescription: “Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fee paid by the eligible textile sector enterprises for
items.schemeName: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial support to beneficiaries for their children's (maximum two) education at various levels, including higher secondary, graduation, post-graduation, and professional courses like engineering and medical studies.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Education of Children

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial aid for the marriage of eligible beneficiaries or their dependent sons/daughters (up to two marriages).
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Marriage

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries every 5 years to support the purchase of spectacles, ensuring better eye health and vision.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial relief to the beneficiaries in case of permanent disability due to accidents or their dependents/nominees in case of accidental or natural death.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Death and Permanent Disablement

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to transport workers who are hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance on Hospitalization

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, beneficiaries, upon retirement or unfortunate demise, will have 50% of their last drawn amount transferred monthly to their families through a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Family Pension

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides monetary support to help cover funeral costs in the unfortunate event of a beneficiary's demise.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Funeral Expenses

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to a beneficiary on successful delivery of a child or miscarriage by such beneficiary or his wife.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Maternity Benefit

items.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance for the treatment of beneficiaries or their family members suffering from major ailments like cancer, TB, brain stroke, cardiac problems, and others.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Medical Benefit for Major Ailments

items.briefDescription: The scheme provides pension benefits to transport workers of the state upon reaching 60 years of age.
items.schemeName: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Pension

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to protect the endangered Whale Shark, the world's largest fish, along the Gujarat coast, a crucial breeding site. It mitigates threats from fishing by providing compensation for damaged nets and cultivates a strong conservation ethic among local fishermen and the broader public.
items.schemeName: Whale Shark Conservation Programme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide wheat at ₹1 per kg to Antyodaya, BPL, and State BPL beneficiaries to ensure food security and reduce financial burden.
items.schemeName: Wheat at One Rupee per KG Scheme (NFSA)

items.briefDescription: Punjab State Government started a pension for widow and destitute women.
items.schemeName: Widow / Destitute Women Pension Scheme - Punjab

items.briefDescription: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Widow B.Ed Scheme" for Widow/abandoned women.
items.schemeName: Widow B.Ed Scheme-Rajasthan

items.briefDescription: Department of WCD, Delhi Government is implementing various Financial Assistance for the benefit of different sections through Financial Assistance Cell. Department of WCD is running Widow’s Daughter Marriage(WDM) for the benefit of widows/women in distress.
items.schemeName: Widow Daughter Marriage Scheme

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.
items.schemeName: Widow Pension (CBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹3,000/- is given to the widow of a registered construction worker who is not receiving a similar benefit from any other Government/ Department/ Board/ Corporation /PSU.
items.schemeName: Widow Pension (HBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: Widow pension in Uttar Pradesh is a social welfare scheme by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to widows residing in the state. The scheme is administered by the Women Welfare Department of the state government.
items.schemeName: Widow Pension - Uttar Pradesh

items.briefDescription: The "Widow Pension Scheme" launched by HPBOCWWB is designed to support widows of registered beneficiaries. Through this initiative, the Board will disburse a monthly amount of ₹1,500/- to help widows manage their expenses and improve their quality of life.
items.schemeName: Widow Pension Scheme (HPBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The West Bengal government's Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department launched the "Widow Pension" scheme in 2010. This program aims to support widows facing economic hardship within the state.
items.schemeName: Widow Pension-West Bengal

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the rehabilitation of widows by encouraging marriage through a monetary incentive. It provides a grant to bona fide Himachali men (above 21 years) and women (above 18 years) at the time of marriage.
items.schemeName: Widow Re-marriage Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide reimbursement of fees for widowed or abandoned women who have taken admission in B.Ed courses in teacher training institutes located in Rajasthan.
items.schemeName: Widow/ Abandoned Chief Minister (B. Ed) Sambal Yojana

items.briefDescription: Widow/Abandoned/Single Woman Pension Scheme of Himachal Pradesh Government aims to provide financial help to widows, abandoned women, and unmarried women shall be entitled to receive pension for a sum of Rs.1,150/-per month.
items.schemeName: Widow/Abandoned/Single Woman Pension Scheme

items.briefDescription: The objectives of the scheme are to bring more areas under cultivation during the normally lean winter season under different crops other than paddy and increase production and productivity of various crops like cereals, pulses, oilseeds, and vegetables during the Rabi season.
items.schemeName: Winter Cropping & Development of Cultivable Land Scheme

items.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to protect farmers' crops from damage caused by wild and stray animals by providing financial assistance for wire fencing around farms.
items.schemeName: Wire Fencing Around the Farm for Crop Protection

items.briefDescription: "Women Helpline" provides 24X7 emergency and non-emergency response through the telephonic short-code 181 to women
items.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
items.schemeName: Women Helpline

items.briefDescription: The “WISE-SCOPE Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India with the aims to provide opportunity to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their S&T knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society.
items.schemeName: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER)” aims to build scientific capacity, retain and promote women researchers in India & Germany by utilizing complementary expertise in science, technology, innovation and research partnerships.
items.schemeName: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and support meritorious female students in Rajasthan who have performed well in their Higher Secondary examinations and are pursuing higher studies.
items.schemeName: Women Merit Scholarship

items.briefDescription: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates to pursue research in frontier areas of science and engineering, preferably those having a break in career (minimum two years) and not having regular employment, to explore possibility of re-entry into the profession.
items.schemeName: Women Scientist Scheme-A

items.briefDescription: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates with break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. Women scientists who wish to apply under this scheme are required to develop their own project/proposals for scientific and technological solutions
items.schemeName: Women Scientist Scheme-B

items.briefDescription: A scheme by MoST for female candidates with a break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. 1-year training is provided in Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), patent search, know-how, drafting, filing, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright.
items.schemeName: Women Scientist Scheme-C

items.briefDescription: The "Women Self Employment Scheme" encourages women to become self-reliant and supports their efforts in establishing small-scale industries or trade ventures, thereby improving their economic status & promoting self-employment opportunities across the state providing them financial assistance.
items.schemeName: Women Self Employment Scheme

items.briefDescription: 'WIDUSHI' programme aims to encourage and support senior women scientists to conduct research in interdisciplinary areas of Science and Technology.
items.schemeName: Women’s Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovation

items.briefDescription: The "Workers In Case of Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to registered Building and Other Construction (BOC) workers in the case of permanent disablement.
items.schemeName: Workers In Case Of Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB

items.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2018, the "Workers for Class 9th to 12th" scheme, under the MUHAFIZ Scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., J&K, provides ₹1,200 per year for up to two children of registered BOC workers through the National Scholarship Portal.
items.schemeName: Workers for Class 9th to 12th Through National Scholarship (JKBOCWWB)

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Working Women Hostel" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Haryana aims to provide safe and affordable accommodation to working women. Through this scheme, hostel facilities at subsidized rent are provided to employed women.
items.schemeName: Working Women Hostel

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide affordable and reliable domestic drinking water connections to eligible households in selected semi-urban areas of Uttarakhand, ensuring improved access to safe and adequate drinking water.
items.schemeName: World Bank-funded Uttarakhand Drinking Water Programme (For Semi-Urban Areas)

items.briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to provide lifelong financial assistance of ₹15,000/- per month as a measure of relief to World War II ex-servicemen and their widows who are not receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source.
items.schemeName: World War II Pension

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs," was launched by the Dept of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt of Maharashtra. Each VJNT family will receive a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5,382 square feet).
items.schemeName: Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support researchers and scientists in attending international scientific workshops and other programs by providing eligible applicants with travel grants covering up to 50% of the expenses (maximum ₹25,000/-).
items.schemeName: Yatra Anudan

items.briefDescription: The "Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides a pass of ₹ 2400/- per three months for non AC DTC bus to the registered workers for purchasing.
items.schemeName: Yatra Pass in DTC non AC Buses for the Construction Workers

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote holistic health and wellness among people of all age groups through yoga, naturopathy, and personalized counseling.
items.schemeName: Yoga Wellness Center

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize young talented artistes who have contributed and continue to work for the development of tiatr, its song and music, and have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Song through All India Radio, Doordarshan and other platforms at national and international levels.
items.schemeName: Young Achievers Awards

items.briefDescription: The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship program, envisaged by the Government of Rajasthan, for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programs, schemes and projects of the government departments.
items.schemeName: Young Interns Program

items.briefDescription: The programme “Young Investigator’s Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB)” is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology.
items.schemeName: Young Investigators Programme in Biotechnology

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote young scientific talent by providing research presentation opportunities, awards, and training fellowships to young scientists of Madhya Pradesh.”
items.schemeName: Young Scientist Program– M.P. Young Scientist Congress

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage youth in arts by providing a monthly fellowship and professional training through government institutions.
items.schemeName: Youth Art Training Fellowship Scheme

items.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to empower young people and youth organisations by providing financial support for development activities. It aims to encourage youth participation in community service, sports, cultural events, and leadership initiatives across Meghalaya.
items.schemeName: Youth Engagement through Empowered Youth Organisations (YESS)

items.briefDescription: The Youth Hostel Scheme is a joint venture of the Central and State Governments of India. It was launched in the early 1960s to promote youth travel within the country by providing low-cost budget accommodation and facilities to students and youth groups traveling on excursions or study tours.
items.schemeName: Youth Hostel Scheme

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote environmental awareness and sustainable practices among students by organizing programmes and activities such as plastic reduction initiatives, kitchen gardening, etc. along with various competitions to engage and empower students in protecting the environment.
items.schemeName: Youth and Eco Club

items.briefDescription: The scheme "Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)" is designed to honour the young Goan individuals who have excelled in the field of Art and culture in Goa. The scheme intends to give recognition to young artists par excellence for their outstanding achievements.
items.schemeName: Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among village-level male and female youth groups (Mangal Dals) by providing financial support for the purchase of essential materials, enabling them to become self-reliant and undertake community-based activities.
items.schemeName: Yuvak Mangal Dal and Mahila Mangal Dal Swavalamban Yojana

items.briefDescription: "Yuvasree" was launched  in 2013 by Labor Department, Government of West Bengal for providing financial assistance to jobseekers.
items.schemeName: Yuvasree

items.briefDescription: The Rajasthan State government started a scheme "Zero Budget Natual Farming" in 2020-21 to promote  natural farming.
items.schemeName: Zero Budget Natural Farming

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide to eligible women/ transgender beneficiaries of Tamil Nadu under the Zero Ticket Bus Travel Scheme for Women, Free of Cost Travel in Government of Tamil Nadu Buses. No Need to Pay any Fare up to 30 Kilometers.
items.schemeName: Zero Ticket Bus Travel Scheme for Women

items.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free household electricity connections are given to the BPL /Lower income group households across the state.
items.schemeName: Zupda Vijlikaran Yojana

items.briefDescription: This scheme was launched with objective of promoting digital education & providing online learning to children from poor & needy families, proving to be a boon for them. Under this scheme, free tablets are provided to students, enabling access to state-of-the-art software & learning materials.
items.schemeName: e-Adhigam Scheme - Free Tablet

items.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the sons and daughters of small and marginal farmers, agricultural laborers, and market workers of Uttarakhand to pursue higher education in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, Horticulture & other related fields.
items.schemeName: scholarship scheme - Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board, Uttarakhand

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Exposure Tour For The Coir Artisans” by the Dept of Industries and Commerce, Union Territory of Puducherry is introduced for acquiring the latest techniques and innovative ideas in various coir units located in other states, the exposure tour will be conducted for the coir artisans.
items.schemeName: “Exposure Tour for the Coir Artisans” Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme

items.briefDescription: “Family Counseling" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the residents of Puducherry are provided with counselling, rehabilitative and referral services.
items.schemeName: “Family Counseling" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry State Social Welfare Board

items.briefDescription: Through the scheme “Home for the Aged", the senior citizens are provided with stay at subsidiary rates, food (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian), routine health check up by doctors thrice in a week, providing news papers and television for entertainment.
items.schemeName: “Home for the Aged" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)

items.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Education and the University Grants Commission. Taking special interest with regard to the promotion of higher education in the NER, i.e. for improving the GER, promoting higher education, and encouraging children belonging to the economically weaker sections.
items.schemeName: “Ishan Uday” Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region

items.briefDescription: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The senior citizens are provided free health checkups and free medicines.
items.schemeName: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)

items.briefDescription: The awards are conferred to the individuals who have shown exceptional courage, especially in adverse circumstances in coming to aid, protecting or helping beyond the call of duty and assisting in dealing with the victims of any type of violence, attack or harassment against women and girls.
items.schemeName: “RAKSHAK PURASKARS’’ Award

items.briefDescription: The scheme “Training in Coir” by the Dept of Industries and Commerce, UT of Puducherry aims to promote and develop Coir and Coir-based industries in the region. Additionally, it focuses on providing a 6-month training to the rural poor in producing coir products to generate employment.
items.schemeName: “Training in Coir” Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme

items.briefDescription: Launched on 15 August 2018, the scheme "₹5 Lakh Insurance Cover for Farmers" is an Insurance Scheme by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana. This scheme provides ₹5 lakh insurance coverage to all farmers aged between 18 and 60 years.
items.schemeName: ₹ 5 Lakh Insurance Cover To Farmers
